purpose: Complete old-English comparison source; not the LionWing translation authority.

techniques.name: Berserker
techniques.flavor: To stagnate is to forget your purpose, to still is to die. Here you'll live, each scar a mark of pride, each beat of your heart a melody all your own. When we live slowly Bacchus weeps.

levels.name: Revenge
levels.text: When you take a Wound, you may spend 1 Focus to immediately take an Action with a cost of 1 at no cost and with Swift. This can only be done [Tension + Tier] times per Turn.

levels.name: Take A Beating
levels.text: Gain [Tier] additional Guts. When you're reduced to 0 gain [Tier] less health.

levels.name: Cornered Dog
levels.text: When you would receive an Effect, you may choose to take a Wound instead.

techniques.name: Dragonslayer
techniques.flavor: That thing was too large to be called a sword. Too big, too thick, too heavy, and too rough, it was naught but a heaping hunk of iron.

levels.name: Speed Is Weight
levels.text: Your successful Body Finishers Shred your target after dealing damage.

levels.name: Wide Arc
levels.text: When you spend 3 or more Focus on a Body Finisher, you can change its target to a 2x2 Zone placed on yourself, without targeting you.

levels.name: Titanic Heave [ Breathe Body Finisher ]
levels.text: The → Finisher counts all dice as Hits, pushes enemies it hits 2 spaces back, and Weakens you after it resolves.

techniques.name: Duelist
techniques.flavor: What's wrong, can't you hit me? You were so adamant you would only need one strike. So go on. Strike me.

levels.name: Riposte [ Block Skirmish ]
levels.text: The Skirmish lets you → move 3 spaces before targeting and Taunts your target on a Success.

levels.name: Parry
levels.text: Using Block against an adjacent character Dazes your attacker.

levels.name: Deflecting Blow
levels.text: When you use Block on an Attack from a range of 2 or more, you may spend 1 Focus to Skirmish a character within 5 spaces of the attacker.

techniques.name: Flagellant
techniques.flavor: There is no fate that cannot be surmounted by scorn.

levels.name: Thrill
levels.text: When you receive a Negative Effect, you may also Strengthen yourself.

levels.name: Blood Rush
levels.text: The first time you Skirmish each Turn, before targeting, you may Blight yourself to move up to 2 spaces in a Line. If your target is Adjacent, You gain 1 Advantage for each space moved. When you Blight yourself while already Blighted using "Blood Rush" you Mark yourself and may move one additional space.

levels.name: Bled Dry
levels.text: You are unaffected by Negative Effects, so long as you have 3 or more Wounds.

techniques.name: Gunslinger
techniques.flavor: Adept fixers know their guns as well as they know themselves; each part maintained and accounted for. Famous fixers just need to let shots fly.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Big Iron
levels.text: You now use ‘Bullets' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with 6 Bullets. To Skirmish, you must spend at least 1 Bullet and target 1 character in 4 spaces. For every extra Bullet spent, gain 1 Advantage, or choose an additional target.

levels.name: Lock And Load
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When you end your turn without Attacking, you can set your Bullets to 6.

levels.name: Bullet Juggle
levels.text: When you Skirmish one character while spending 3 or more Bullets, you Launch them.

techniques.name: Struggler
techniques.flavor: LET IT RUN THROUGH YOUR BLOOD! FEEL YOUR SYSTEM ERUPT! GIVE A FUCK WHAT YOU SAID! WE ALL LIE IN THE MUD!

levels.name: Effort
levels.text: When you roll a 1 in any Challenge roll, you may reduce your Speed by 1 for the duration of the Scene (to a minimum of 1) to treat it as a 6 instead, converting it to a Critical Hit. If you cannot lower your Speed, you receive [Tier] damage instead.

levels.name: Adrenaline
levels.text: When you take a Wound, you may move up to 3 spaces towards an enemy of your choice. If this brings you adjacent to the enemy, you may Mark them.

levels.name: Defy Reason
levels.text: You may use the effect of "Effort" on any roll that comes from a Finisher, regardless of value.

techniques.name: SpellSword
techniques.flavor: Versatility is a power you can't buy. It must be learned through a complete mastery of all of its parts.

levels.name: Spell Blade
levels.text: Wherever you use a Skirmish or Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it benefit from your Techniques that would normally affect Casts, not including the other levels of "Spellsword".

levels.name: Twin Suns [ Cast Skirmish ]
levels.text: The Skirmish is → Swift, has its cost reduced to 0. When using it, you can Teleport to a space in 3 range before targeting.

levels.name: Witch Hunter [ Cast Body/Talent Finisher ]
levels.text: If → the Finisher targets the same character as the Cast, it deals [Spirit] additional damage.

techniques.name: Technician
techniques.flavor: A fighter is not their body, but a collection of techniques and experiences.

levels.name: Stretch
levels.text: When you Charge, you ‘Stretch'. After Stretching, until the end of your next Turn, completing a Combo gives you 1 AP, this cannot trigger on the same combo more than once per Turn.

levels.name: Perfect Form
levels.text: When you complete a Combo, you gain 1 Armor until the start of your next Turn.

levels.name: Final Blow [ Skirmish Finisher ]
levels.text: The Finisher → costs 1 AP.

techniques.name: Unbroken
techniques.flavor: You must not give in! You cannot! Claw and bite like a cornered rat! It's the only option you have left.

levels.name: Get Back Up
levels.text: Once per Scene, you may spend an Influence to put it On The Line at no cost. Doing this makes you lose the ability to gain Influence for the remainder of the Scene.

levels.name: Furious Revival
levels.text: When you spend an Influence in a combat Scene, you may take an Action with a cost of 1 for no cost with Swift.

levels.name: Phoenix
levels.text: When you put it On The Line using "Get Back Up" you may heal all your wounds but 1.

techniques.name: Braggart
techniques.flavor: You weren't even worth cleaning up the stains…

levels.name: Hubris
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Pride', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. After you do one of the following, fill one Segment of this Clock: ‣ Get hit by an enemy's Attack without using a Defensive Reaction. ‣ Attack rolling one of your two lowest Attributes. While your Pride Clock is full, you gain 1 Advantage on all Rolls for the remainder of the Scene.

levels.name: Prove Yourself
levels.text: When your Pride Clock fills, you may ‘Hold Back', emptying the Clock and reducing its total Segments by 2 (to a min of 2). If your Pride Clock has less than 6 Segments, "Hubris" grants one additional Advantage for every two Segments it is less than 6.

levels.name: A Worthy Opponent
levels.text: When an enemy deals a Wound to you, you may fill a Pride Segment.

techniques.name: Breacher
techniques.flavor: A hundred pellets at 1600 feet per second hurts about as much as you would expect.

levels.name: Buck Shot
levels.text: Your Skirmishes can target a character in 4 spaces instead of its normal targeting. Your Skirmishes Against targets in 2 spaces push your target 1 space away on a success.

levels.name: Both Barrels
levels.text: When you Skirmish, so long as you're not Weakened, you can choose to fire ‘Both Barrels'. Doing this gives the Attack [Body/2] Advantage, but also Weakens you after it resolves.

levels.name: Annihilate
levels.text: Your Body Finisher can now target characters up to 3 spaces away and can use the effect of "Both Barrels". When you use "Both Barrels" with a Skirmish or Body Finisher, change its target to a 2x2 Zone adjacent to you.

techniques.name: Dual Wielder
techniques.flavor: My lord used to beat me for my left-handedness. When I killed him, I used both hands. Out of respect.

levels.name: Twinned blow
levels.text: When you Skirmish targeting a single character, you may give it [Tier] disadvantage. If you do, you may ‘Flurry' once, Dealing [Body / 2] or [Talent / 2] damage to the same target afterwards. Flurrying counts as a Swift Skirmish at 0 cost by all other mechanics. Other techniques cannot change Flurry's targeting.

levels.name: Frenzied Barrage
levels.text: When you spend 2 or more Focus on a finisher, you may give it [Tier] Disadvantage. If you do, you may ‘Flurry' twice, each of them targeting a character the Finisher targeted.

levels.name: Varied Blades
levels.text: Your Skirmishes have an additional two effects that alternate every time you use Skirmish, resetting at the start of your Turn (first Skirmish uses effect A, second uses effect B, third uses effect A again). Choose two of the options below as effects: ‣ Astral: Gain [Tier / 2] Focus. ‣ Blazing: Deal [Tier / 2] damage to your target. ‣ Umbral: Teleport to a space within [Tier] spaces. ‣ Vorpal: Restore [Tier / 2] Health. ‣ Phasing: This attack ignores its target's Armor. ‣ Whirling: Move your target [Tier] spaces.

techniques.name: Martial Artist
techniques.flavor: I'm pretty experienced myself y'know, 15 years of Baji Quan, 11 years of Aikido, and a semester of Capoeira. Oh, sorry. We should be dueling about now! I've got a bad habit of bragging when I don't think I'll be seeing someone again.

levels.name: Art Of The 8 Hammers
levels.text: When you successfully Skirmish or Body / Talent Finisher without using a Technique with the Weapon Tag, you can do 1 of the following. Each can be used once per Round. ‣ Quick Step: Move up to 3 spaces. ‣ Binding Blow: Snare your target. ‣ Rising Knee: Launch your target. ‣ Iron Shoulder: Push your target 3 spaces.

levels.name: Flow-State
levels.text: "Art Of The 8 Hammers" gains the following option. ‣ Combo: Deal [Body / 2] or [Talent / 2] damage to a character you've attacked this Turn

levels.name: Unlimited Blows
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When you roll at least one Critical Hit on a Skirmish or Finisher, "Art Of The 8 Hammers" triggers an additional time.

techniques.name: Monastic Sage
techniques.flavor: Born under the twin stars, Qayid Āl-Rashid existed in a state of extremes; his life oscillating between terrible misfortune and unforgettable luck. It was only after he came of age that he learned to balance these chaotic forces, and channel them in battle.

levels.name: Mind Made Manifest
levels.text: While you have Strengthened, gain 2 Armor. While you have Haste, gain 2 Evasion at the end of your Turn.

levels.name: Of Two Worlds
levels.text: When you use an Attack Action or Clash, gain 1 ‘Wrath'. When you use Breathe, Charge, or a Defense Technique (excluding Clash), gain 1 ‘Peace'. If you end your turn with an equal amount of Wrath and Peace (minimum 1 each) you may spend 1 of each to gain both Strengthened and Haste.

levels.name: Sublime Equanimity
levels.text: You may trigger the end of turn effect from "Of Two Worlds" even if there is a difference of 1 in your Wrath and Peace (this still requires at least 1 of each).

techniques.name: Lancer
techniques.flavor: Mankind is a friend to the spear. We grew in wisdom and technique alongside our oldest defender. Know this, vile foe: this thrust carries the weight of all human history behind it!

levels.name: Pierce
levels.text: Your Skirmish and Body Finisher can target one enemy up to 2 spaces away instead of its normal targeting. Your Skirmishes gain Advantage equal to your target's distance from you (up to a maximum of 3).

levels.name: Phalanx
levels.text: Your Skirmish and Body Finishers can target an enemy up to 3 spaces away instead of its normal targeting. Skirmish targets all enemies between yourself and your original target(s), dealing half damage to each.

levels.name: Cannon-Arm [ Breathe Skirmish ]
levels.text: The Skirmish → can target a space in 4 spaces and raises the maximum Advantage from "Pierce" to 4. If the attack had 4 or more total Advantage, it additionally targets all spaces adjacent to the original, dealing half its damage to said targets. Each affected space becomes Difficult Terrain.

techniques.name: Predator
techniques.flavor: I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I hunger. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you. I see you.

levels.name: Yearn
levels.text: The first time you Investigate each Turn, it becomes Swift and has its Cost Reduced to 0. However, it can only be used to ask what your target's current and maximum Health is. When any opponent is Knocked Out while adjacent to you, you heal a Wound.

levels.name: Obsess
levels.text: When you know an opponent has half their maximum Health remaining, your Speed is increased by 3, and you ignore Difficult Terrain, but you cannot move unless you're moving closer to at least one of said opponents.

levels.name: Devour
levels.text: Once per Scene, when you heal a Wound using "Yearn" you may ‘Indulge', Immobilizing and Dazing yourself. While you're under these Effects, the Focus gained through Breathe and Charge are replaced with healing an equal number of Wounds.

techniques.name: Improvisational Fighter
techniques.flavor: I'll take all you bastards on! I'll flatten your whole damned Pavilion! You'll rue the day you slighted me! And the record will be written with your scars! Well… I would say that if I still had my sword. Until then, a concussion and some splinters will do.

levels.name: Everything's A Tool
levels.text: You may always Interact to create a piece of 10 Health Terrain in 5 spaces of you —identifying some mundane object to do so—or remove adjacent Terrain you've created to make a Swift Skirmish or Cast action using any Attribute for its Roll.

levels.name: Oh! That One Hurt!
levels.text: You may Interact at no cost and with Swift once per Round, so long as it doesn't result in an Attack. Attacks from Interact have 3 Advantage.

levels.name: Last Resort
levels.text: Once per scene, you may attack using "Everything's A Tool", even if there isn't a piece of terrain to remove. This use gains [Tension] Advantage.

techniques.name: Warring Ascendant
techniques.flavor: My dearest brother, born on the battlefield. I know you expect more, but I implore you. Lend me your strength, and feel the air on your skin. I call upon you in my time of greatest need, heed, o' Durandal!
techniques.notes: Transformation. Can't take with other transformations.

levels.name: Heavenly Arm
levels.text: Choose a Technique with the Weapon Tag. Once per Scene, when you Charge with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 spaces of you 3 spaces away. While Transformed you count as having all three Levels of the Technique you chose. When you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.

levels.name: Esoteric Blades
levels.text: Choose one other Technique of any kind, while you are transformed you count as having the first two Levels of that Technique.

levels.name: Saintly Sword, Durandal
levels.text: You may choose to lose your Transformation when you use your Finisher, if you do so that Finisher can target all enemies along a ∞ space long Line, where at least one targeted space is adjacent to you, dealing one additional damage for each character it targeted.

techniques.name: Aerial Master
techniques.flavor: Once, the mysteries of green silk were known only to hidden sages, carefully weaving each small patch into the wondrous flying carpets of yore. Today, though, it is a foolish clan head who does not keep a few green silk coats in their armory, lest their rivals gain uncontested control of the skies.

levels.name: Over And Around
levels.text: Anytime you are Hastened you enter the ‘Flight Stance', removing any other Stances you had. While in the Flight Stance you force [Tier] Disadvantage on incoming Attacks, ignoring the effects of Terrain while moving, and letting you move through enemy spaces.

levels.name: Soar
levels.text: When you Jump, you may Hasten yourself rather than moving.

levels.name: Falling Ax Strike
levels.text: The Attacks you use while in the Flight Stance can roll [Speed] rather than an Attribute, doing so removes Hastened and Launches your target.

techniques.name: Assassin
techniques.flavor: A bloodied coin spends just as well as any other.

levels.name: Ambush
levels.text: if the first Action you take after Deploying is Hide, it has no Cost and ignores its requirements.

levels.name: Assassinate
levels.text: Attacks you make while Disappeared gain [Tier] Advantage, let you reappear adjacent to characters, and the dice rolled Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

levels.name: Speed of Dark [ Hide Stride ]
levels.text: The Stride has no → cost and grants you Invisible when used.

techniques.name: Sniper
techniques.flavor: The unseen attack is unrivaled in its lethality.

levels.name: Long Shot
levels.text: Your Talent Finisher can target characters up to 5 spaces away instead of its normal targeting.

levels.name: Bunker Down
levels.text: When you end your turn without Attacking you may "Bunker Down", gaining Immobilized. While you're Immobilized your Talent Finishers gain 5 additional range and Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

levels.name: Deadeye [ Hide Talent Finisher ]
levels.text: The Finisher → deals one additional damage for each Critical Hit, one additional damage for each space between yourself and your target target (as per any of the shortest paths), and targets all enemies between yourself and your original target (as per any of the shortest paths).

techniques.name: Skirmisher
techniques.flavor: Float like a butterfly…

levels.name: Sting
levels.text: Once per Turn as a 0 Cost Action you may ‘Jab' an adjacent character at no Cost. A Jab deals [Talent/2] damage to its target and is counted as a Swift Skirmish by all other mechanics; features other than this Technique cannot change a Jab's damage or targeting.

levels.name: Shifting Blows
levels.text: You may move up to two spaces in a straight line before or after using a Skirmish.

levels.name: Rebound
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. If movement provided by Skirmish makes you leave adjacency with a character, you may target them with said Skirmish in addition to your normal targets. Targets added via "Rebound" take half damage unless it was dealt by a Jab.

techniques.name: Speed Demon
techniques.flavor: It was over before it even started. I don't know who you pissed off, but they moved like nothing that I've ever seen.

levels.name: Fade
levels.text: You can move through enemies. You still must end your movement in an empty space.

levels.name: Flash Step [ Breathe Stride ]
levels.text: The Stride lets you → triple the distance you can move.

levels.name: Flash Strike
levels.text: When you move out of a character's space using "Fade" you may deal [Talent / 2] damage to them (this is not an Attack). You can't use this on the same target more than once each Round. When you trigger this while using "Flash Step" you may Launch any characters you damage.

techniques.name: Untouchable
techniques.flavor: And what's this! It looks like she can't be hit! They're moving at speeds I can't even keep up with! Champ looks like she's boxing ghosts!

levels.name: Duck
levels.text: The first time you Dodge each Round gain [Talent / 2] additional Evasion.

levels.name: Weave
levels.text: Increase the spaces moved when using Dodge to three spaces. When your Evasion reduces a source of damage to 0 you may move as if you Dodged.

levels.name: Fighter's Instinct [ Dodge Skirmish ]
levels.text: The → Skirmish lets you move 3 spaces before targeting and lets you Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

techniques.name: Acrobat
techniques.flavor: Obstacles are found everywhere. In overcoming them, we nourish ourselves.

levels.name: Flying Kick [ Jump Skirmish ]
levels.text: If the Skirmish is → against one adjacent target it gains Advantage equal to the number of spaces you moved during your Jump, up to a max of [Talent].

levels.name: Wall Jump
levels.text: When you end a Jump's movement adjacent to a piece of terrain or board edge, you may move an additional 3 spaces in a straight line and gain 1 Evasion. This additional movement is considered part of the Jump's total movement. You can only "Wall Jump" once per Turn.

levels.name: Weightless Body
levels.text: You may "Wall Jump" any number of times in a Jump. You can't use the effect of "Wall Jump" on the same terrain or board edge more than once per Jump.

techniques.name: Blade Master
techniques.flavor: A weapon's strength is secondary to the strength of those who wield it.

levels.name: Draw Stance
levels.text: When you Breathe or Charge, you may enter ‘Draw Stance', removing any other Stances you had. This effect ends after you Attack, Stride, or Jump. When you use a Talent Finisher in Draw Stance, you can Crit on rolls of 5 or 6.

levels.name: Divide In One Motion [ Breathe Jump ]
levels.text: The → Jump does not end Draw Stance. After using the Jump, you may use a Talent Finisher at no cost. The Finisher targets all enemies you moved into adjacency with or through during your Jump.

levels.name: Leaping Koi
levels.text: When you use "Divide In One Motion" roll the Finisher before using your Jump's Movement. For every Critical Hit rolled in the Finisher you may move an additional 3 spaces in a straight line. This additional movement is considered part of the Jump's total movement.

techniques.name: Cunning Fighter
techniques.flavor: Heavy Build. Tall. Reach advantage. Confident, capable. Trained in the four forms of Cavalcabo. Their salute will transfer into a sudden flèche. This has served them well against inexperienced opponents. Bind the attack, then transfer to a quick glide. During their shock, apply knee to groin. Begin gloating.

levels.name: Plan and Execute
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Cunning Plan' a 4 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. When you Investigate a character you haven't Investigated in the Scene, fill one Cunning Plan Segment. Once per Turn, you may empty a Segment to take any non-Attack Action, reducing its cost by 1 and gaining Swift.

levels.name: Plans Within Plans
levels.text: "Plan and Execute" is no longer once per Turn.

levels.name: At a Glance
levels.text: The first time you Investigate each Turn you may spend 1 Focus to Investigate all characters in a 2x2 Zone within [Mind] spaces.

techniques.name: Egomaniac
techniques.flavor: Only the most conceited, self-important, piece of sho'vah grit could do what you do." "No, that's not a damn compliment!

levels.name: Peak Condition
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Style', a 4 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. Whenever you Attack, fill one Style Segment for each of the following conditions that it fulfilled. When you're hit by an Attack, you empty one. When you fill the Clock, empty it, move up to 2 spaces in a straight line, and gain 1 AP. ‣ Drama: The Attack rolled 2 or more Critical Hits. ‣ Dance: The action before the attack moved you Adjacent to the target. ‣ Diversify: You didn't use the Attack on your last Turn. ‣ Denouement: The Attack brought you to 0 AP.

levels.name: Taunt, Flaunt, Daunt
levels.text: When you fill your Style Clock, you may forgo the AP gained to Taunt or Fear all Enemies within 3 spaces of you.

levels.name: Finale
levels.text: When you Charge, you may fill [Tension × 2] Segments on your Style Clock, these can carry over between Clocks. After you do this, you lose the Style Clock for the remainder of the Scene.

techniques.name: Enchained
techniques.flavor: These scars and bindings are a reminder of what I was. And in keeping them, I remind myself of what I can be.

levels.name: Hook Shot
levels.text: When you Cast targeting a non-adjacent unoccupied space, you may ‘Swing'. When you do, track your distance from the target, and Teleport to any space an equal distance away from the target.

levels.name: Draw In
levels.text: When you Cast targeting an opponent, you may choose not to deal damage. If you do, the Cast has its Cost reduced to 0, move one space towards them, and pull them one space towards you, repeating until you're both adjacent.

levels.name: Momentum [ Cast Skirmish ]
levels.text: If movement → provided by your Cast moved you adjacent to the target of your Skirmish, you gain [Tier x 2] Advantage on that Skirmish and you push them 4 spaces on a success.

techniques.name: Knife Juggler
techniques.flavor: Though it's fallen slightly out of favor, thrown weapons have been a part of our culture for hundreds of years, and it's time people start respecting that.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Throw
levels.text: You now use ‘Weapons' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with 4 Weapons. When you Skirmish, you can choose to ‘Throw', spending 1 Weapon, reducing its cost to 0, and letting it target one character up to 4 spaces away instead of its normal targeting.

levels.name: Resupply
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When you resolve a Skirmish with Throw, place a ‘Weapon Marker' in the space you targeted or an unoccupied space adjacent to it. When you move into a Weapon Marker's space, you may remove it to move 1 space in any direction and gain 1 Weapon.

levels.name: Chaser
levels.text: When an enemy moves outside a Weapon Marker, you may Teleport to the marker and use a Swift Skirmish on them (paying its costs), this Skirmish can't use Throw.

techniques.name: Malicious Mimic
techniques.flavor: Impossible… she only saw that technique once!

levels.name: "Anything You Can Do…"
levels.text: After successfully avoiding an Enemy's Attack using a Dodge or Clash, you gain an ‘Impression' with the same name as the enemy. As an action with no cost, you may spend any of your Impressions to use the indicated Enemy's Attack as if you were an enemy. All Impressions are lost at the end of a Scene.

levels.name: Rehearsed Movements
levels.text: When you attempt to Dodge an enemy while you hold an Impression matching their name, you gain 2 additional Evasion.

levels.name: "…I Can Do Better"
levels.text: When using "Anything You Can Do…" you may spend 1 AP to use the enemy's Ace rather than their Attack.

techniques.name: Modified Meister
techniques.flavor: You feel the vibration of whirring chains, the sound of spinning gears, the buckling of mismatched plating and loose screws, it almost feels like it's alive.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Running Hot
levels.text: You now use ‘Heat' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with 0 Heat, you may substitute any focus costs with gaining an equal amount of Heat instead, effects that would normally give Focus reduce your heat instead. If your Heat increases to 6 or more it is immediately reset to 3, and you explode, dealing [Mind] damage to yourself and all adjacent opponents.

levels.name: Overload
levels.text: When you Skirmish or Finisher you may "Overload", gaining [Mind / 2] Advantage and Blighting the target(s), afterwards you receive 1 Heat for every dice that was not a Hit.

levels.name: Overclock
levels.text: When you Breathe with at least 2 Tension you may ‘Overclock' until the end of your next turn. While Overclocked dealing or taking any amount of damage generates 1 Heat and whenever you would explode you may instead set your Heat to 3 to take [Mind / 2] damage, move up to 3 spaces, and gain 1 AP.

techniques.name: Opportunist
techniques.flavor: You were really expecting a fair fight?

levels.name: Pack Tactics
levels.text: Once per Round, when an ally resolves an Attack on a character within [Talent] spaces, you may Swiftly Skirmish targeting them at no Cost. If you are outside the Skirmish's range, you may Teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to the target before choosing your target(s).

levels.name: Hungry Eyes
levels.text: When an ally within [Talent] spaces targets a character with an attack, you may spend 1 Focus to Mark the target.

levels.name: Launcher Combo
levels.text: Once per Round, when an ally inflicts an Effect to an enemy within [Talent] spaces, you may use the effect "Pack Tactics" on the same target. This level has a separate once per Round limitation from the one in "Pack Tactics".

techniques.name: Reflector
techniques.flavor: Strike me if you dare.

levels.name: Catch The Blade
levels.text: At the beginning of your turn, you may name any number and note it down until the end of the scene. When you take damage (from a source other than yourself) equal to a number you've noted, you gain [Talent] Evasion before the damage is dealt.

levels.name: Watch And Wait
levels.text: Whenever you take damage (from a source other than yourself), you may note another number with "Catch The Blade". Enemies who attack you cannot roll additional dice with their Critical Hits.

levels.name: To Carry Their Fury
levels.text: When you reduce an attack's damage to 0 with Evasion, you may teleport adjacent to the attacker and Swiftly Skirmish them at no cost. When you make an attack and deal damage equal to a number you noted, you may remove any of your noted numbers to deal two additional damage for each removed.

techniques.name: Dim Mak
techniques.flavor: Topple the Goliath, find the minute weaknesses in everyone you face, disassemble their idiot stances, fight dirty, and have a plan to kill everyone you meet.

levels.name: Study Weakness
levels.text: When you Investigate a character, your next Investigate against them is Swift, the third Investigate each turn is Swift and has its Cost reduced to 0. When you Investigate a character, you may place a ‘Weak Point' in an unoccupied space adjacent to them. Weak Points move to match their host's movement. When you attack a character while standing on one of their Weak Points, you may remove that Weak point to roll using your Mind and make the attack Swift.

levels.name: Field Investigation
levels.text: When an attack fails to hit you, you may Swiftly Investigate the attacker at no cost. When you remove a Weak Point, you gain 2 Evasion.

levels.name: 4-Point Execution
levels.text: Track the number of times you remove a Weak Point on a character in a Turn. When you remove a Weak Point 3 times on one target, you may Teleport to any unoccupied space adjacent to them and perform a Mind Finisher on them at no cost.

techniques.name: Drunkard
techniques.flavor: Avoidance "A little something to take the edge off~

levels.name: Down The Hatch
levels.text: If it is not clear to every player, establish what direction is "up" after Deploying. When you Breathe you may choose to ‘Drink' Slowing yourself. Once per turn, when you start or end your Turn while Slowed you must roll a d6, and move one space in a line based on the result. If a 1 was rolled move up, if a 2 was rolled move right, if a 3 was rolled move down, if a 4 was rolled move left, if a 5 or 6 was rolled you may move in any direction (including diagonally). When involuntary movement would move you adjacent to, out of adjacency with, or have your movement prevented by an enemy you may deal [Tier] damage to them, up to once per type of trigger per enemy per turn.

levels.name: Fool's Dance
levels.text: When you end your Turn while Slowed, gain Evasion equal to [Tier] + the number of Negative Effects on you.

levels.name: Chug
levels.text: The first Breathe on your Turn is Swift. When you Drink while Slowed you Shred, Weaken, and Blight yourself. If you have 3 or more Negative Effects at once you may ignore the effects of each. The movement from "Down The Hatch" now triggers when you have any Negative Effect, and when triggered with two or more Effects has you move at the start and end of your Turn.

techniques.name: Master-At-Arms
techniques.flavor: Effects "You thought that was the last one?

levels.name: Multi-Faceted
levels.text: Gain the three following ‘Armaments' each one has a condition, and when you Skirmish while that condition is fulfilled you ‘Equip' it, replacing any Armament you had Equipped before. Each Armament can only be Equipped once per Turn. ‣ Blade: When you Skirmish while exactly 2 spaces away from an enemy and adjacent to none. This Skirmish is Swift, before targeting, move one space. After resolving the Skirmish, Strengthen yourself. ‣ Pole: When you Skirmish 2 adjacent enemies. This Skirmish is Swift, and pushes your targets 3 spaces away from you. After resolving the Skirmish, Launch and Slow your targets. ‣ Chain: When you Skirmish while exactly 4 spaces from your intended Target. This Skirmish is Swift and targets one character 4 spaces away from you. After resolving the Skirmish, Shred and Blight your target.

levels.name: Like Water
levels.text: The 2nd time you Equip an Armament each Turn you gain 1 AP and Hasten yourself.

levels.name: Master At Work
levels.text: When you use a Talent Finisher while you have an Armament Equipped, you gain a bonus based on the Armament. ‣ Blade: Move two spaces ignoring characters, if you passed through the Finisher's Target Mark and Launch your target. ‣ Pole: This Finisher targets a 2 space Line drawn from your space. If this Finisher Spikes a Launched character gains an additional [Tier] Advantage and the spaces you targeted become Difficult Terrain. ‣ Chain: This Finisher targets all enemies in a 1x1 Zone centered on a space adjacent to you, for each Critical Hit you roll that Zone expands by 1 space in every direction (1x1 > 3x3 > 5x5…) and deals one additional damage.

techniques.name: Crusher
techniques.flavor: It's said that in order to effectively counter an oncoming force, one would need 5 times the force to stop it. I assure you… I have that.

levels.name: 30,000 Tons
levels.text: When you Skirmish you may choose to ‘Raise', targeting no characters, Reinforcing yourself, and Taunting all adjacent enemies. When you Skirmish while Reinforced you must ‘Fall', dealing double damage and losing Reinforced.

levels.name: Hammerfall
levels.text: When you Fall after taking at least 5 pre mitigation damage since the end of your last Turn you target all spaces adjacent to you instead of your normal targeting and Weaken all targets.

levels.name: You Look Like A Nail
levels.text: When you Fall after taking at least 10 pre mitigation damage since the end of your last Turn you deal triple damage.

techniques.name: Giant Frame
techniques.flavor: Woah. You're bigger in person. Like. Way bigger. Oh right, the armor, right away sir!

levels.name: Big Arms
levels.text: When you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 additional Focus to have it target each character in a 2x2 Zone adjacent to you so long as at least one of those spaces are adjacent to you.

levels.name: Immense
levels.text: You may take up a 2x2 section of spaces rather than one space when you Deploy, if you do so you freely move through 1x1 enemies and Terrain. Gain [Tier] Guts. When you choose your size, you must stick with it until your next Tier up.

levels.name: Shockwave
levels.text: When you use a Body Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it target all spaces adjacent to you, deal half damage, and have it Launch its targets.

techniques.name: Iron Bodied
techniques.flavor: Mushir Ahmed has a reputation for his displays of confidence. Most famously is his armor, it covers his legs and arms but leaves his chest bare. It baffles advisors and opponents alike..

levels.name: Tough As Stone
levels.text: You can never have a Speed lower than 3 and can always move using your own Actions, ignoring all other rules to the contrary.

levels.name: Resilience
levels.text: Gain [Body / 2] Armor.

levels.name: Stainless Stride
levels.text: At the beginning of your Turn, you may Immobilize yourself. While Immobilized, you can never take more damage than 4 + [Tier/2] in one instance (after all forms of damage reduction).

techniques.name: Vanguard Defender
techniques.flavor: If I get hurt, don't stop running.

levels.name: White Knight
levels.text: You may Block Attacks that target allies within [Body] spaces, when you do so you Teleport to a space adjacent to the ally being targeted and become the target instead.

levels.name: Steel Angel
levels.text: The first Block you use each Round has no Focus cost and gives you [Tier] Armor until the start of your next Turn, if you're Blocking for your allies.

levels.name: Inspire Courage
levels.text: When you start a source of movement by moving out of adjacency with an ally, they may move to a space adjacent to your new location and Reinforce.

techniques.name: Absolute Bastard
techniques.flavor: You're an expert at making strangers hate you, huh?

levels.name: Easy To Hate
levels.text: When you Investigate an enemy, you may use this Technique to Taunt them. This can only be used 3 times per Scene.

levels.name: Bully
levels.text: Once per turn when you Taunt a character you may move up to 3 spaces towards them, if you move into adjacency with them, you may Snare them and gain 1 AP.

levels.name: Add Injury To Insult
levels.text: Your Attacks against characters you've Taunted gain [Tier] Advantage.

techniques.name: Battle Jockey
techniques.flavor: One of the most fearsome gangs is Pantomime, the infamous "Cavalry", riding diesel guzzling steeds. These petty criminals are known across the guild city for their "Night rides", driving around their turf and encircling anyone who dares standing in their way.

levels.name: Trusty Steed
levels.text: After Deploying, you may Summon a Mount with a Tier equal to your Tier adjacent to you. This Mount cannot redirect targeting with its Passive.

levels.name: Grasping Jaws
levels.text: When your Mount attacks an enemy, you may have it Taunt them.

levels.name: Roaring Entry
levels.text: Once per Scene when your Mount would take its Turn, you may have it Roar instead. When your Mount Roars, it Dazes all enemies in 3 spaces of it, pushing them 3 spaces away.

techniques.name: Grappler
techniques.flavor: Make way for Pantomime's blazing star!" "The killer king with the inescapable pin!" "The one, the only… Raphaël Blasé!

levels.name: Restrain
levels.text: When you Successfully Body Finisher, Snare your target, characters you have Snared also count as being Taunted by you.

levels.name: Spine Breaker
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When you Spike a single Launched character, you may teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to your target and change the attack you are using into a Body Finisher at no additional cost.

levels.name: Finishing Move [ Body Finisher Jump ]
levels.text: Instead → of moving with this Jump, you and a target of the Finisher Disappear. At the start of the next round or when either of you would be able to take another Action (whatever comes first) you both return to the board in the same space, Launching all other enemies in 2 spaces of you, and letting you Swiftly Body Finisher the initial target at no cost.

techniques.name: Juggernaut
techniques.flavor: His physique spoke to me. It said, "Get the fuck out of my way.

levels.name: Wild Charge
levels.text: When you Jump, you may move [Body] spaces instead of [Talent], deal 30 damage to Terrain you pass through, and move any number of characters you passed through or moved into adjacency with to a space adjacent to you.

levels.name: Violence
levels.text: Once per Round, when you move through or move into adjacency with characters using "Wild Charge", you may deal [Body / 2] damage to them and Launch one of them.

levels.name: Hard Turn
levels.text: When you Jump, you may reduce the number of spaces you move by 2 to make it so you can move without moving in a Line.

techniques.name: Mundane
techniques.flavor: No tricks, no frills, no bullshit. Just sit ups, squats, and plenty of juice
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: For What The Spirit Lacks
levels.text: You now use ‘Tenacity' instead of Focus or AP, gaining and losing it rather than the former. You start each Round of combat with 1 Tenacity + [Body / 2], and you must spend it in place of Focus and AP. You can't gain Tenacity using Breathe or Charge. You can't use Cast or Spirit Finishers.

levels.name: Dig Deep, Stand Firm
levels.text: When you are targeted by an Attack, you gain 1 Tenacity.

levels.name: In The Face Of The Beyond
levels.text: When you Breathe or Charge, you may Taunt a number of characters equal to the Focus you would have gained within 4 range. When rolling for Charge, you may Roll Body instead of Spirit.

techniques.name: Rising Challenger
techniques.flavor: Two swordsmen lock blades silhouetted by moonlight, the impact reverberating throughout the streets, blowing out a nearby streetlamp. One survivor lives on, regretting every second of it.

levels.name: Perfect Deflection
levels.text: When you perform a successful Clash, you gain 1 Focus and can move [Tier] spaces.

levels.name: "You'll Have To Get Through Me!"
levels.text: You may Clash with Attacks that target allies within [Talent] spaces. When you Clash, you may Teleport to a space adjacent to the character who initiated the attack.

levels.name: Drama And Spite
levels.text: Gain 3 Advantage in Clashes.

techniques.name: Runic Retribution
techniques.flavor: To truly love something you must let it kill you.

levels.name: Lash
levels.text: When an ally is hit by an Attack you may Swiftly Cast the attacker regardless of range at no Cost.

levels.name: Loving Rite
levels.text: When you would Investigate you may offer a ‘Deal' to an ally in its range instead. If they take this deal they may Swiftly take any 1 Cost Action at the cost of being Marked. If they don't take the deal you restore any AP spent.

levels.name: Devotion
levels.text: When an ally takes the deal from "Loving Rite" they may also ‘Double Down', Marking an enemy of their choice and making both Marks applied unable to be removed for the remainder of the Scene. When an ally you've Marked takes any Action they may choose to move one space towards any Marked enemy.

techniques.name: Shield Bearer
techniques.flavor: They stood their ground. A breathing, bleeding wall between the people they had sworn to protect, and the coming darkness.

levels.name: Wall
levels.text: When you Block, you may spend 2 Focus to gain [Tier] additional Armor, and retain the Armor until your guard is broken, or you start your Turn.

levels.name: Shield Charge
levels.text: When you Block, place a ‘Shield Marker' in a space adjacent to you until you stop blocking. The Shield Marker moves to match your movement. When your movement would move your Shield Marker into an opponent's space, you may remove the Marker to deal [Body / 2] damage to them and push them 2 spaces.

levels.name: Focused Defense
levels.text: While you have a Shield Marker, indicate a 3×3 Zone centered on it. If an enemy attacks you while inside that Zone, you count as having [Tier] additional Armor for the Attack.

techniques.name: Stalwart Sentry
techniques.flavor: Nothing gets past me, at least not in one piece.

levels.name: Guardian
levels.text: So long as you haven't moved during your turn. The spaces diagonally connected to your count as being adjacent when it would benefit you.

levels.name: On Watch
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Vigilance', a 4 Segment Clock that's filled at the start of every Scene. You may empty one Segment of this Clock when performing a Punish to have it not cost AP. When you Charge you refill the Vigilance Clock.

levels.name: Zone Of Influence
levels.text: When you Investigate you may place up to 4 ‘Spotlights' in any unoccupied space on the board. A Spotlight is a unique piece of Difficult Terrain that only affects enemies. When a character enters a Spotlight you may teleport to an unoccupied adjacent space and Punish them as if they left adjacency with you.

techniques.name: Beastial Ascendant
techniques.flavor: Don't worry, this happens to everyone your age.
techniques.notes: Transformation. Can't take with other transformations.

levels.name: Beastly
levels.text: Choose two non-Modifier Enemy Types. Once per Scene, when you Charge with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', pushing all enemies within 2 spaces of you 3 spaces away and restoring [Guts x 2] Health. While Transformed you can use your Enemies' Attacks, said attacks lose any additional damage from Tension. When you're reduced to 0 Health while Transformed, it ends, and you're Dazed.

levels.name: Inheritance
levels.text: Choose one of the two Enemies you chose when gaining "Beastly". You gain that enemy's Passive while Transformed. If the Passive triggers when the user is Knocked Out, it triggers when you end your Transformation instead.

levels.name: Apex
levels.text: When you're Transformed you can use one of your enemies' Aces by spending 2 AP. Each of your Aces can only be used once per Scene.

techniques.name: Guardian Angel
techniques.flavor: I don't exactly know where it came from. I just know it protects me when I need it. It's given me this one chance to change things for the better.

levels.name: Two Bodies
levels.text: Upon Deployment, your character is split into two separate spaces: the ‘Guardian' space and the ‘Defendant' space. When you move, you move both the Guardian and Defendant separately. When you Cast, it must draw its range from the Defendant space. When you Skirmish, it must draw its range from the Guardian space. When the Defendant receives damage, it is dealt as a Wound instead, or 2 Wounds if the damage dealt was more than their Guts.

levels.name: Together In Life
levels.text: When you successfully Cast, the target becomes Weak. When you successfully Skirmish a Weak character, you Launch the target(s).

levels.name: Together In Death
levels.text: Your Health and Guts now scale off your Spirit instead of your Body. If an ally is Attacked within 4 spaces of the Guardian, you may spend 1 Focus to have the Guardian teleport adjacent to them and become the target of the Attack.

techniques.name: Servant's Call
techniques.flavor: Tybalt's Fairy is a strange thing, it stays hidden whenever it can. Its ability to shield and mend is invaluable for an imperial guard, but he worries something's wrong with it, with every beast they fend off it stares at the body longer, and when tensions rise he hears sobbing.

levels.name: A Subordinate's Honor
levels.text: When you Cast targeting an empty space, you may spend 1 Focus for each empty space and create a Tier 1 Guardian, Slime, or Paladin Summon there. It can only do 1 damage when it attacks and has half its normal Health. You can only have [Tier] Summons from this Technique at a time.

levels.name: Hero's Hymn
levels.text: When you Charge you may Teleport one of your Summons into a space adjacent to you. Until the start of your next turn, that Summon must be targeted instead of you if you're targeted by an attack.

levels.name: Supreme Servant
levels.text: Once per Scene when you use a Spirit Finisher targeting one empty space, you may spend 3 Focus and create a Tank Summon of your choice with a Tier equal to yours. That enemy is a named character who has a Rank 3 Bond with you.

techniques.name: Mecha Pilot
techniques.flavor: Runic alignment complete. Aether levels nominal. We got this partner. For Oberooooon!

levels.name: Rune Core Engine
levels.text: You enter all combat Scenes with a ‘Suit' adjacent to you. This is a 2x2 piece of terrain with 15 Health and [Tier] Armor. By Interacting with it, you put the Suit on. This removes the Terrain, grants you [Tier] Armor, and makes your character 2x2 in size. You may use Interact again to leave the Suit, losing these benefits and placing the terrain adjacent to you in sufficient empty spaces.

levels.name: Autonomous
levels.text: The Suit is now a Summoned non- Modifier Enemy of your choice with a Tier equal to yours, so long as you don't have it on. It is still 2x2 in size and counts as both Terrain and an Enemy, regardless of the enemy chosen (if this summon would have more than 15 health raise it to be equal to the summon's health). When your Summon takes its Turn, you may choose to Skirmish a character adjacent to it in place of one of its Attacks.

levels.name: Perfect Sync
levels.text: You may Interact with the Suit after Deployment at no Cost. Even when you are in the Suit, it may still take Turns as a Summon, sharing your space and moving you when it moves. While you are in the Suit, the Summon is Dazed.

techniques.name: Battle Instructor
techniques.flavor: Keep your back straight!" "Strengthen your footing!" "Remember the plan!" "..." "That was good, keep at it, kid.

levels.name: Strike Order
levels.text: When you Mark a character, you may choose an ally, that ally may move up to 3 spaces towards the character. Your Investigates are Swift.

levels.name: Teaching Moment
levels.text: When an ally Rolls, you may spend 1 Influence to Bond with them or upgrade their Bond Rank and let them reroll, taking the highest result.

levels.name: Remember Your Training
levels.text: Once per Scene you may use the "Lead" Bond Action in combat at the cost of 3 Focus and 1 AP rather than Influence, the objective must be "Attack X".

techniques.name: Empath
techniques.flavor: Don't Worry, everything'll be okay.

levels.name: Calming Aura
levels.text: Allies who start their turn adjacent to you may choose to lose any one of their Effects and become Strengthened.

levels.name: Protective Response
levels.text: When an ally within [Talent] spaces takes a Wound or Effect from a source other than themselves you may Break Out at no Influence cost so long as it moves you adjacent to them.

levels.name: "Are You Ok?"
levels.text: You may use the "Reassure" Bond Action in combat at a cost of 3 Focus and 1 AP rather than Influence.

techniques.name: Gourmand
techniques.flavor: Cooking is like painting or writing a song. Just as there are only so many notes or colors, there are only so many flavors—it's how you combine them that sets you apart.

levels.name: Healthy Meal
levels.text: You have one ‘Meal' that refreshes each Intermission, you may Interact to hand an adjacent character your Meal. A character given a Meal can eat it immediately, or save it and eat their Meal when they Breathe. When a character eats a Meal, they can restore a Wound and gain [Tier + Mind + 10] Health.

levels.name: Bottomless Pantry
levels.text: Gain two additional Meals per Intermission.

levels.name: Shared Experiences
levels.text: When someone you're Bonded with eats one of your Meals you both gain [Mind] Focus.

techniques.name: Heavenly Saint
techniques.flavor: When allies falter, your presence is the whispered promise of safety.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Strength Of Prayer
levels.text: You now use ‘Faith' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with [Spirit] Faith. You can't gain Faith using Breathe or Charge, you gain 1 Faith when you target an ally with an action or the effect of a Technique.

levels.name: Cleansing Light
levels.text: When targeting an ally with Cast you don't deal damage, cannot deal Negative Effects, and instead heal [Hits / 2] Health to your target(s) have all Effects of their choice removed from them.

levels.name: Grand Restoration
levels.text: Your Spirit Finisher gains the effects of "Cleansing Light". When using a Spirit Finisher on an ally, they begin Regenerating and lose a Wound (The Wound healing can only be done once per character per Scene).

techniques.name: Precognizant
techniques.flavor: I already won.

levels.name: Flash Of Insight
levels.text: Once per Round, after any Roll from an enemy or willing ally, you may spend 1 Focus to force its initiator to redo it. This can only be used [Mind] times per Scene.

levels.name: Take Advantage
levels.text: When using "Flash Of Insight" against an enemy's Attack the attack's target gains [Mind/2] Evasion.

levels.name: Hurl Into The Infinite
levels.text: When you hit a character with your Mind Finisher, you may spend 2 additional Focus to Daze and Immobilize them.

techniques.name: Surgeon
techniques.flavor: To blessed Hippocrates, I grant an offering. Let my hands remain steady and true. Let not guide this soul to Thanatos' waiting grip. This I swear. This is my Virtue.

levels.name: Do No Harm
levels.text: When you Skirmish an ally, you may choose to ‘Operate' on them. When you Operate you must roll Mind instead of Talent or Body, and your target restores [Hits / 2] Health rather than taking Damage.

levels.name: Operational Procedure
levels.text: When you take this feature or when you take an Intermission, lose any stocks of ‘Bandage' or ‘Disinfectant', then make a Mind Roll. For every odd number rolled, gain one Bandage. For every even number rolled, gain one Disinfectant. When you Operate you may expend any number of Bandages to heal an equal number of Wounds, and/or any number of Disinfectant to remove an equal number of Effects.

levels.name: Miracle Worker
levels.text: Gain 3 Advantage on your "Do No Harm" Roll. When you roll two or more 1s or two or more 6s with "Operational Procedure" you may replace the resources gained by those dice with a ‘Miracle'. When an ally is Knocked Out, place a marker where they were. When you Skirmish targeting this Marker; you may expend a Miracle to bring the Knocked Out character back to that space or an adjacent one if it's occupied with 1 Health and no Wounds.

techniques.name: Talisman Caster
techniques.flavor: Every surface is covered in small, intricately detailed papers. This sort of obsessive protection seemed silly to her, but when removing one of these seals resulted in voices echoing around the room, she reconsidered.

levels.name: Sacred Seal
levels.text: When you Breathe, you may place a ‘Talisman' on an adjacent character or space. Spaces and characters with these Talismans on them are always valid targets for your Casts, no matter the distance.

levels.name: Tossed Talisman
levels.text: When using "Sacred Seal" you may place Talismans in 3 Range, and when you Charge you may do this three times in a row.

levels.name: Exorcize
levels.text: Your Spirit Finisher can target all characters and spaces with a Talisman on them at once.

techniques.name: Alchemist
techniques.flavor: Eye of newt and toe of frog, Wool of bat and tongue of dog, Adder's fork and blind-worm's sting, Lizard's leg and owlet's wing, For a charm of powerful trouble, Like a hell-broth boil and bubble.

levels.name: Quick Mix
levels.text: When you Breathe, you can make one of the following ‘Potions'. You may always Interact to use one of these potions on yourself or a character within 4 spaces of you. 1: Pure Water: Remove any Effect(s) from the target. 2: Fury Vapors: Strengthen the target. 3: Growth Serum: Regenerate the target. 4: Adrenaline Stim: Hasten the target. 5: Stoneskin Balm: Reinforce the target. 6: Vilethorn Poison: Blight the target.

levels.name: Powerful Mix
levels.text: When you use a potion on an ally they gain [Mind / 2] Focus. When you use a potion on an enemy you may deal [Mind] damage to them.

levels.name: High Intensity Mix
levels.text: You may forgo the Focus gained from Breathe to trigger "Quick Mix" two more times, randomly determining the potions with a D6 roll for each rather than choosing.

techniques.name: Chronomancer
techniques.flavor: Time until death: T- 2 minutes 4 days 10 days 2 weeks 1 month 1.5 months 3 months 5 months 1 year 5 years 6 years 6.5 years 10 years 25 years

levels.name: Accelerate
levels.text: When targeting an ally with Cast you don't deal damage, cannot deal Negative Effects, they may move spaces equal to the damage you would have dealt, and then Hasten them.

levels.name: Decelerate
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. As a 0 AP Cost reaction to an Effect on any character being removed, you may spend 1 Focus to apply the Effect to them again.

levels.name: Time Stop
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Flux', a 8 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. When you apply an Effect to an ally fill one Flux Segment. Once per Scene, when you start your Turn with a full Flux Clock you may spend all your AP to empty it and Cast targeting all characters in the Scene. If there are two or fewer enemies you may take a Wound to go All Out and turn your roll against them into a Finisher.

techniques.name: Dancer
techniques.flavor: The intimacy of combat is something that's difficult to recreate. That intoxicating passion has drawn more people together than you can possibly know.

levels.name: Dance Partner
levels.text: You may always Interact with a willing character to set them as your ‘Partner'. You may only have one Partner and lose them if you end your Turn outside of adjacency. When a Partner moves willingly, their Partner may move to a space adjacent to them and gain Haste.

levels.name: Hearts In Tandem
levels.text: When a Partner Hides, or gains Focus, their partner gains the benefits in addition.

levels.name: The Prestige
levels.text: When a Partner uses a Finisher, their Partner may Daze themselves to have the Finisher Crit on rolls of 5. Using this effect makes the user lose their Partner status.

techniques.name: Fog Walker
techniques.flavor: When the fog rolls off the river Undine, the city streets are empty. For the darkened hunts would find those who do not flee, meeting those who carry a smile as easily as a blade.

levels.name: Blowing Smoke
levels.text: When you Breathe on your Turn, you may forgo the Focus gained to create ‘Fog' in a space adjacent to you. At the end of your Turn, move your Fog up to 2 spaces in any direction. If you or an ally starts their Turn in Fog, they may Disappear. When a character Disappeared through this level reappears, they must do so in Fog, or as close as possible.

levels.name: Mystic Mist
levels.text: When a character reappears in Fog, they gain [Mind] Evasion and move up to 3 spaces.

levels.name: Stinging Steam
levels.text: Your Breaths are Swift. When you Stride you may forgo the Focus gained to move your Fog Clouds up to 2 spaces and deal 2 damage to enemies every time a Fog Cloud passes through them.

techniques.name: Last Hope
techniques.flavor: He felt stupid. There it was, his face plastered on the gray brick in front of him. A blurry picture of it, but his face nonetheless. These posters must have been put up by someone he's helped, claiming he was some mythic savior. A reputation that would only make his life harder. What annoyed him most, though, was a certain someone now knew he wasn't going to stop.

levels.name: Notably Absent
levels.text: You may Assist at the start of any combat Scene regardless of your character's condition. When you Break Out while Assisting allies, you may give them an Effect based on the Action taken, the actions and effects are as follows: ‣ Stride: Hasten. ‣ Breathe: Reinforce. ‣ Investigate: Strengthened.

levels.name: Heroic Return
levels.text: At the start or end of any Turn where the Tension is 4 or higher you may return to the board from your Assisting on any border space. When you return to the board, you gain all Positive Effects your allies have. These Effects can't be removed until combat ends.

levels.name: Explosive Return
levels.text: As soon as you return to the board, you may take a Turn, even if it would interrupt the turn of an Enemy. If this interrupted an ally's Turn you must wait for them to finish.

techniques.name: Replicator
techniques.flavor: An infinite barrage of bullets and blades. A force that resembles an army but was born from a single hunter with a mage at their side.

levels.name: Echo Form
levels.text: When you Cast targeting only an ally or yourself, you don't deal damage. Instead, create an ‘Echo' adjacent to them. You can only have 3 Echos using this Technique at a time. Echos are targetable pieces of Difficult Terrain with 1 Health. A character with an Echo may draw range from their Echos.

levels.name: Symmetry
levels.text: When a character with an Echo moves, they may move their Echo an equal number of spaces.

levels.name: Full Sync
levels.text: Characters with an Echo start the Round with 1 additional AP per Echo they have. Characters benefiting from this give Swift to their Attacks, so long as each draws its range from a different Echo.

techniques.name: Will-O-Wisp
techniques.flavor: A heretical idea to most, artificial fairies able to be used by the non-keeper guards employed by Eberon. Despite the disapproval of most, more and more "royal keepers" have been appearing as of late.

levels.name: Spirit Weaving Flame
levels.text: When you Charge for the first time in a scene you may create you "Spirit Flame", a marker that you can move up to 4 spaces when you Stride and when you end your Turn, it is also pushed one space when it's space is targeted with an attack. When a character is standing on or adjacent to your Spirit Flame they count as having an effect. Choose an option from the list below to determine the effect: ‣ Dreamy Spirit: Enemies are Slowed. ‣ Angry Spirit: Enemies are Blighted. ‣ Insightful Spirit: Enemies are Marked. ‣ Intense Spirit: Allies are Hasted. ‣ Kind Spirit: Allies are Regenerating. ‣ Violent Spirit: Allies are Strengthened.

levels.name: Friendly Spirits
levels.text: When an ally moves out of your Spirit Flame you may have it move to a space adjacent to their new position. When an enemy attempts to move out of your Spirit Flame you may spend 1 Focus to stop their movement after they move out of that space, leaving them adjacent to the Spirit Flame.

levels.name: Twinned Spirits
levels.text: You may choose an additional option from "Spirit Weaving Flame", and when you create a Spirit Flame you may choose to create two, one of each type, or create one with the properties of both.

techniques.name: Artist
techniques.flavor: The 7th Battalion has been described as "Avant-garde." Both meanings are equally accurate.

levels.name: Stroke Of The Brush
levels.text: You may always Interact to ‘Paint' on an adjacent space in a ‘Color' of your choice. Each Color has a specific effect that triggers when you or an ally enters its space or starts their Turn in it for the first time in a Round. The Colors are as follows. ‣ Red: Strengthen yourself. ‣ Yellow: Teleport to another Colored space. ‣ Blue: Gain 2 Focus. ‣ White: Push any enemies in 3 spaces 3 spaces. ‣ Black: Pull any enemies in 5 spaces adjacent to you.

levels.name: Canvas Of Flesh
levels.text: When you Interact with an ally, you may spend 3 Focus to create a ‘Seal' on them, letting them gain the effect of one of your Colors every time they end their Turn.

levels.name: Brush-Brand
levels.text: When you Skirmish a character, you may ‘Brand' them with a Color of your choice until the end of your next Turn. When you or an ally successfully Attack a Branded character, they gain the effect of the chosen Color.

techniques.name: Bardic Savant
techniques.flavor: Doesn't it all seem to have a rhythm to it? When the bullets are flying and everyone else is in chaos, that rhythm guides me.

levels.name: Musician
levels.text: When you Breathe, you gain a ‘Verse' of your choice from the list below. You can hold up to 5 Verses at a time (Including repeated verses). When you use Charge, you may expend all the Verses you are holding and grant the effects listed on them to characters in a range of your Mind. ‣ Harsh: Allies Strengthen and may move 1 space. ‣ Soothing: Allies gain [Mind] Health. ‣ Inspiring: Allies gain 1 Focus. ‣ Raucous: Enemies are Shredded and Weakened and take 1 damage. ‣ Frantic: Affected allies may choose to use any 1 Cost Utility action at no cost.

levels.name: Quick Composition
levels.text: Once per Turn, when you Breathe you may forgo the Focus given to reduce its cost to 0. Your Breaths are Swift.

levels.name: Encore
levels.text: When you Charge with 3 or more Verses, you may forgo the Focus given to reduce its cost to 1.

techniques.name: Deckbuilder
techniques.flavor: My father's deck has no pathetic cards!

levels.name: Draw
levels.text: After deploying, roll one die and set it aside. These dice are your ‘Cards'. When you Breathe with three or fewer Cards, roll a new Card. When you Cast you may spend any of your Cards to roll [Mind] instead of [Spirit] and gain the Card's assigned bonus. The bonuses granted by each Card are as follows: 1: Illness: Does not deal damage. Blights the Target. While the target is Blighted, they are also Slowed. 2: Etteilla: When targeting an enemy, you restore Focus equal to the damage dealt. 3: Night: Does not deal damage. The target Disappears and becomes Invisible. 4: Protection: Does not deal damage. Reinforces the target, this Effect is not lost at the end of Turn. 5: Union: Teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to the target and Snare them. 6: Folly: Does not deal damage. Dazes, Immobilizes, Launches, Fears, and Taunts the target.

levels.name: Card Trap
levels.text: At any time you would gain a new Card, you may refrain from rolling to place a ‘Trap' on an unoccupied space adjacent to you instead. A Trap is a piece of Difficult Terrain that, when stepped on, forces you to Swift Cast at no Cost targeting the character on it while rolling a new Card and immediately spending it to add its effects. This removes the Trap.

levels.name: Greed
levels.text: "Draw" has you roll double the Cards in all scenarios, and you may gain Cards by Breathing when at or below 5 cards instead of 3.

techniques.name: Bloodletter
techniques.flavor: I don't kill people, doctor. What I do is much worse.

levels.name: Bleeding Edge
levels.text: Your successful Skirmishes and Talent Finishers Blight the target.

levels.name: Bloodhound
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When a non-adjacent enemy takes damage from Blight, move up to 3 spaces. If it brings you adjacent, you may remove the Blight to Swift Skirmish them at no cost.

levels.name: Rupture [ Skirmish Breathe ]
levels.text: If the Skirmish → targeted a character with Blight, make a Talent Roll and trigger the effect of Blight [Hits] times.

techniques.name: Chemist
techniques.flavor: Now there's a smell you can feel!

levels.name: Sublimation
levels.text: When resolving an action targeting a piece of Terrain, you may destroy it to create a 3×3 Zone of ‘Gas' centered on its space that disappears at the start of your next Turn. When an enemy enters Gas they are Weakened. Allies in the Gas gain 3 Evasion when they're targeted by attacks coming from outside the Gas.

levels.name: Experimental Mixture
levels.text: When you Weaken a character you may ask the Narrator what it's current Health is, if it's at or below [Mind] that character is Knocked Out and you gain 2 Focus.

levels.name: Deposition
levels.text: When you create a Gas Zone Weaken and deal [Mind] damage to all enemies in the spaces it covers. When you defeat an enemy with "Experimental Mixture" create a 3x3 Gas Zone centered on them.

techniques.name: Constrictor
techniques.flavor: Whips, garrotes, nooses, you'd be surprised how many people are killed with glorified string.

levels.name: Wrap
levels.text: Your Successful Skirmishes with 1 target Snare the target. At the end of your Turn, you can move all characters you've Snared up to 5 spaces. You do not need to pull characters you've Snared when you move.

levels.name: Choke
levels.text: Your Body and Talent finishers can always target characters you've snared. Your Finishers deal [Tier] additional damage to Snared characters.

levels.name: Twisting Impact
levels.text: Your Skirmishes gain 1 Advantage. When "Wrap" moves two or more characters adjacent, they receive [Talent] damage.

techniques.name: Cutpurse
techniques.flavor: It's an easy job, in-and-out, no need for worries, no need for anyone to get hurt. Bump into Āl-Amir just after sunset and slip your hand into his pouch. Be sure to apologize and offer something, historically he'll refuse.

levels.name: Fast Hands
levels.text: When you leave adjacency with an enemy on your Turn (once per character per Turn), you may end your movement to do one of the following, that you haven't used on your Turn. ‣ Disarm: Weaken them. ‣ Trip: Immobilize them. ‣ Steal: Gain 2 Focus.

levels.name: Snatch
levels.text: When you inflict certain Negative Effects on an enemy, you may gain its positive version. The Effects this applies to are as follows. ‣ Blight: Regenerate. ‣ Immobilize / Snare: Hasten. ‣ Shred: Reinforce. ‣ Weaken: Strengthen.

levels.name: Thief In The Night
levels.text: After you Hide, you can use "Fast Hands" without ending your movement and lets you use options you've already used on your Turn. This lasts until the end of the Turn.

techniques.name: Mind Breaker
techniques.flavor: Day 4: I still haven't seen any of my fellow keepers, it seems we've all fallen to the same curse affecting me, this fog seems to go on forever and strange beasts accost me at every turn. My energy is running low, and I can only hope those beasts are edible.

levels.name: "Where Are You?"
levels.text: While Casting you can choose to have that Cast not deal damage, if you do the Cast Banishes its target if it only targets one character. Characters you've Banished can be targeted, but if they are dealt damage by a non-Banished player character they lose Banished. You may have any number of characters Banished at a time.

levels.name: "What Do You Do?"
levels.text: Enemies you've banished are Marked while they're Banished, allies you've Banished are Strengthened while they're banished.

levels.name: "Who Are They?"
levels.text: Characters you've Banished do not lose Banished at the start of their Turn if they're the only banished character. When you have two or more enemies banished at the end of your Turn, you may move each of them [Mind] spaces, if two of them move adjacent you may force one of them to attack the other.

techniques.name: Reaper
techniques.flavor: The people of the Gardens knew well to put out their offerings at solstice. For as the days grew long, the Harvesters of Krouses would make pilgrimage, seeking homes lacking piety to become their bloody crop.

levels.name: Sow
levels.text: When you successfully Skirmish one Character, you may Teleport them to another space adjacent to you. The first time you use this each Turn, you Mark your target.

levels.name: Tend
levels.text: Enemies in 3 spaces of you don't lose Marked when they end their turn.

levels.name: Reap
levels.text: If you start your turn in 5 spaces of a Marked enemy, you may spend 3 Focus to Teleport to an unoccupied space adjacent to them and use a Finisher on them at no cost. If you are then in 5 spaces of another Marked enemy, you may repeat this effect at a Focus cost of 1 using a Skirmish instead of a Finisher. This cannot target the same enemy more than once.

techniques.name: Tactical Master
techniques.flavor: Your ideas of combat are so limited, here, paint you a picture of how far this canvas reaches.

levels.name: Stop And Think
levels.text: Anytime you are Weakened you enter the ‘Tactician Stance', removing any other Stances you had. While in the Tactician Stance when your non-Attack Actions and Effects you apply deal damage gives you 1 Focus, up to [Mind] times per turn.

levels.name: Study
levels.text: When you Breathe, you may Weaken yourself to gain 2 additional Focus.

levels.name: Eureka!
levels.text: When you start your turn in Tactician Stance, you gain 1 additional AP, and your first attack on this turn costs 1 more AP..

techniques.name: Autophage
techniques.flavor: The Students of Mardrus were widely renowned in their day, creating the doctoring profession as we know it. Shame their achievements are overshadowed by the human cost of their good work.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Transfusion
levels.text: You no longer use Focus. When you would spend, or lose your Focus, you use 2 Health for each point of Focus instead, when you gain Focus gain an equal amount of Health instead. When you successfully Attack a character with two or more different Effects, you begin Regenerating.

levels.name: Overexert
levels.text: When you successfully Attack, you may take 5 damage to roll a D6. Apply an Effect to your target based on the result of the roll. When you have [Guts] or less Health, you may use this without taking damage. 1-2: Blight 3-4: Daze. 5-6: Immobilize.

levels.name: Born Of Mutable Flesh
levels.text: Once per Scene, when you use a Spirit / Body Finisher you may trigger Overexert twice and change its targeting to all enemies with more Health than you.

techniques.name: Earth Speaker
techniques.flavor: You lost the moment you touched the ground.

levels.name: Tectonic Shift
levels.text: When you move Terrain you didn't create or another character, you create a piece of Terrain with 10 Health and 0 Armor in the space it left.

levels.name: Earthen Shards
levels.text: When you destroy or move a piece of terrain, you may deal [Tier] damage to all enemies adjacent to its new position. Each enemy can only be damaged by this effect once per Turn.

levels.name: Stone Soldiers
levels.text: When you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher you may move a piece of terrain adjacent to you into a space adjacent to your target, doing so gives the Attack 3 Advantage and destroys the terrain after the Attack resolves.

techniques.name: Inhuman Strength
techniques.flavor: Mom always said the best way to move people is with words, but picking up that bus seemed much faster.

levels.name: Strong-Arm
levels.text: When you Shove you may push your target up to 5 spaces in a Line, pushing any characters it moves into to the nearest possible unoccupied space. If you push them adjacent to an opponent you may Launch all characters involved. You may target Terrain with your Shoves.

levels.name: Piston Fist
levels.text: When you Successfully Skirmish or Body Finisher a character, you may push them [Body - Target's Armor] spaces.

levels.name: Smash Through
levels.text: When you push a character into a piece of Terrain, both take [Body] damage. If the Terrain is destroyed, the character continues moving for another 3 spaces. This additional movement can only be triggered once per push.

techniques.name: Street Fighter
techniques.flavor: Who's lookin' to scrap!

levels.name: Bloody Brass
levels.text: When you Shove a character, you Daze your target.

levels.name: Break And Bruise
levels.text: When you Skirmish a Dazed character without using a Technique with the Weapon Tag it has Advantage equal to the number of different Effects on your target.

levels.name: Brutalize
levels.text: You may now trigger "Break And Bruise" when targeting Dazed enemies with Body Finishers. The Finishers turn all Advantage from it into additional damage on a success, in addition to Immobilizing and Snaring their target(s) after damage is dealt.

techniques.name: Swarm Body
techniques.flavor: I could see them wriggling under his coat, and the glare over his glasses didn't help me feel safer. They tried to explain the mission to me but I could barely pay attention, there were times where… something crawled across the ground out of sight and the conversation would suddenly stop. It always seemed like it was glaring at me, despite me not being able to see any of its eyes. I'm getting shivers just thinking about it

levels.name: Fluttering Form
levels.text: When you end your turn or are targeted by an attack you may spend 1 Focus to release a "Swarm" in your or the attacker's space. Swarms are spaces of difficult terrain that only restrict enemies and deal [Tier] damage to enemies who enter them or start their turn in them. When you start your turn you may move each of your Swarms up to 3 spaces.

levels.name: Vanish Into Flies
levels.text: When you Disappear you may also create 3 Swarms within 2 spaces of the space you left.

levels.name: Devour
levels.text: When an enemy would take damage from a Swarm while two or more other Swarms are within 2 spaces of it you may remove those additional Swarms from the board to Blight the enemy who took damage and deal [Tier x 2] damage to them.

techniques.name: Siren
techniques.flavor: Lure and tempt, free them all of their inhibitions, show them that the world holds better things for you and them, before you rip it all away.

levels.name: You wouldn't hurt ME, would you?
levels.text: When you Investigate an enemy, you may use this Technique to Fear them. This can be used 3 times per Scene.

levels.name: Irresistible
levels.text: Once per turn when you Fear a character you may force them to move up to 3 spaces towards you, if they move into adjacency with you, you may Daze them.

levels.name: A little help over here?
levels.text: When you successfully Spirit or Mind Finisher a character, you may have all enemies affected by Fear move their Speed towards your target and Attack them with Skirmish or their Attack if they are adjacent.

techniques.name: Wave Rider
techniques.flavor: Yvon was never known for much, didn't make a fuss, didn't make enemies, and didn't make a name for himself. But there were places where his name was whispered in reverence. Old knights told tales of the boy most free, never chained down, no kings, no clients, no masters. Never lingering, he appeared silently and passed through crowds like flowing water. Though sometimes this reputation bothered him, he felt his life could do with a little more attachment.

levels.name: Gentle Waves
levels.text: Your Casts that target one empty space are always Swift, and the first Cast you use on your Turn that fits this condition has no Cost. When you target an empty space with a Cast or Spirit Finisher, you may place a ‘Wave Seal' in that space, up to a maximum of 4 + your Tier Wave Seals placed at a time. When an enemy, willing ally, or you start their turn in or move into a space with a Wave Seal, you may remove it to do one of the following: ‣ Move them up to 2 spaces in a Line. ‣ launch them.

levels.name: Momentous Waves
levels.text: When you move yourself or an ally with the effect of a Technique, the character who was moved deals 1 additional damage on their next Attack on their Turn, up to a max of [Spirit].

levels.name: Aqua Cage
levels.text: If an enemy has a Wave Seal in each of their adjacent spaces, you may remove those Seals to Launch, Daze, and Immobilize them. Each enemy can only be affected by this once per scene.

techniques.name: Gale Strider
techniques.flavor: True freedom doesn't exist in this world. Even the wind cannot blow on forever.

levels.name: Growing Winds
levels.text: When you Cast targeting an unoccupied space or Jump, you may place a ‘Typhoon' in the targeted space / space you left, and all spaces adjacent to it, replacing all other Typhoons you've created. When a character ends their Turn in a Typhoon you may move all characters in the Typhoon 1 space in the same direction.

levels.name: Updraft
levels.text: When you end your Turn you may move any Typhoons 3 spaces in a Line. Any characters who enter the Typhoon through this movement are pushed 1 space in the direction it is moving and are Launched if they are an enemy.

levels.name: Mountain Carver
levels.text: "Growing Winds" and "Updraft" can now move Terrain as well as characters. When you move a piece of Terrain outside of a Typhoon you may have it continue its movement until it moves adjacent to a character, dealing [Tier] damage to that character. If a piece of Terrain would be moved to the edge of the board through this feature it is destroyed.

techniques.name: Hunter
techniques.flavor: Just… one… more… step…

levels.name: Steel Jaws
