levels.text: Your Skirmishes that target one empty space are always Swift. When you target an empty space with a Skirmish or Mind Finisher, you may place a ‘Small Trap' in that space, when an enemy moves over a Small Trap their movement is stopped and you may swiftly Skirmish them at no cost.

levels.name: Far Setting
levels.text: Your Skirmishes that do not target characters have an additional 3 range. Your Skirmishes that come from "Steel Jaws" Immobilize your target.

levels.name: Pit Trap
levels.text: When you set a 2 x 2 area of Small Traps you may convert them into a "Pit Trap", changing the area into Low Terrain and combining the 4 traps into one "Giant Trap". Giant Traps function identically to Small Traps except they let you use a Mind Finisher on the target instead of a Skirmish.

techniques.name: Inner World
techniques.flavor: Pfft. My victory is assured

levels.name: Gaze Deeply
levels.text: When you Charge you may forgo the Focus you would gain to Immobilize all enemies in a range equal to the Focus you would have gained.

levels.name: Domain Of Control
levels.text: Once per scene when you inflict an Effect to a character you may Teleport them and yourself to any space in your ‘Inner World' a separate 3x3 board that no other characters have access to. Once you K.O. them or they deal a Wound to you, you Teleport all living characters in your Inner World to a space on the edge of the normal board.

levels.name: Home Turf
levels.text: While in your Inner World, you gain [Tier] Advantage on all attacks and Duels (this feature carries over to the Duel despite it not being combat). "Domain Of Control" is now [Spirit] times per Scene instead of once per Scene.

techniques.name: Mage's Array
techniques.flavor: Look at where you're standing. Perhaps it's more accurate to say you "were" winning. In the afterlife, practice situational awareness.

levels.name: Inscribe
levels.text: When you Breathe, you may place a ‘Rune' on a space within 4 range. When you Charge you may attempt to connect 3 or more Runes you've placed with Lines to form a polygon, and then Spirit or Mind Finisher targeting all spaces in this polygon (including its lines) at no cost, this removes the Runes.

levels.name: Readjust
levels.text: Before connecting the lines when using "Inscribe" you may Teleport any/all of your Runes up to 3 spaces in any direction.

levels.name: Prison Of Your Own Design
levels.text: When you use the Charge portion of "Inscribe" you may choose to leave the lines on the board until you next use it. The spaces these Lines cover are Difficult Terrain for opponents.

techniques.name: Bombardier
techniques.flavor: Explosion!

levels.name: Explosion!!
levels.text: Your Spirit Finisher can now target a space in 4 Range and all spaces adjacent to it instead of its normal targeting.

levels.name: Explosion!!!
levels.text: When you spend 2 or more Focus on a Spirit Finisher, you may change its target to a 3x3 Zone centered on a space within 5 spaces of you.

levels.name: EXPLOSION!!!!
levels.text: When you spend 4 or more Focus on a Spirit Finisher, you may change its target to a 5x5 Zone centered on a space within 6 spaces of you.

techniques.name: Rapid-Fire Sorcery
techniques.flavor: Don't look away! This is a master at work!

levels.name: Proliferate
levels.text: When you Cast or Spirit Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to ‘Rapid Fire' instead. While Rapid Firing, you roll damage before targeting (meaning you cannot be affected by things that apply advantage / disadvantage when targeting) and may divide all damage dealt between any number of characters within 5 spaces. You don't need to divide this damage equally.

levels.name: Scorched Earth
levels.text: When you deal damage to an empty space, you may turn it into Difficult Terrain. When enemies move into or start their Turn in Difficult Terrain created by you, they receive [Tier] damage.

levels.name: Endless Fire [ Charge Cast ]
levels.text: The Cast gains → Advantage equal to the number of different enemies you could target + the current Tension.

techniques.name: Ritualist
techniques.flavor: Glyphs intertwine, paths converge—within this mesmerizing dance of foci, magic finds purpose.

levels.name: Ley Lines
levels.text: When you Charge you may place a ‘Spell Circle' in your current space, removing any you've already created. When in a Spell Circle space, you can spend up to Tension + 2 Focus on Spirit Finishers.

levels.name: Arcane Artillery
levels.text: When affected by a Spell Circle, your first Spirit Finisher each Turn has 3 additional range and gains [Tension] Advantage.

levels.name: Fractal Etchings
levels.text: If you Charge while on a Spell Circle, you may enhance it for the Scene, doubling the effects of "Arcane Artillery". A Spell Circle can't be enhanced multiple times.

techniques.name: Spellcrafter
techniques.flavor: Everyone thinks an idiot of an innovator.

levels.name: Experimentation
levels.text: You start every Scene with [Mind] ‘Innovation' charges, and may spend one of those charges when you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher to apply an ‘augment' listed below chosen when you obtain this Technique Level. These bonuses are as follows: ‣ Fierce Augment: Damage dealt by this attack is increased by [Mind]. ‣ Focused Augment: Any Zones created by this attack are replaced by 7 space Lines with the same effects. ‣ Wild Augment: Any Lines created by this attack are replaced by 2x2 Zones with the same effects. ‣ Salient Augment: The range and the length of lines created by this attack are increased by [Mind].

levels.name: Solidification
levels.text: You no longer have Innovation charges and may use Experimentation by spending 1 Focus, your starting Focus is increased my [Mind].

levels.name: Finalization
levels.text: You may apply two different Augments to any Cast or Finisher so long as you pay for both.

techniques.name: Student Of Stars
techniques.flavor: Feel the power flow into you, the ears ring with pops and snaps, the forearms go numb and the feet are rooted, with the earth below being your last resort in case everything else goes wrong. Remember your teachings and chants, only when every single one fails will you really know what you're capable of.

levels.name: Power Unleashed [ Charge Finisher ]
levels.text: The → Finisher has its Cost reduced to 1. When you use this Finisher, you spend up to triple the Tension in Focus.

levels.name: Formless Strength
levels.text: When you use "Power Unleashed" you can change its target to a ∞ length Line or a 2x2 space Zone adjacent to you.

levels.name: Moment Of Truth
levels.text: If you enter a Duel with 6 or more Focus you may expend all of it to gain Advantage in that Duel equal to half the Focus you spent.

techniques.name: Cryomancer
techniques.flavor: Each incantation is a flurry of frozen elegance, conjuring storms of ice and swirls of snow.

levels.name: Chill
levels.text: Your successful Casts Slow your target(s).

levels.name: Icicle Halo
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. Begin tracking "Icicle", a 4 Segment Clock that empties after each Scene. When you gain Focus, fill one Segment. When you Breathe you may forgo the Focus gained to empty the Icicle Clock and use half damage Swift Casts, equal to the Segments emptied. If a Cast from "Icicle Halo" targets a Slow character, Immobilize them.

levels.name: Shatter
levels.text: When you target an Immobilized character with a Spirit Finisher, the Narrator must tell you their Health, if their Health is equal to or lower than [Spirit] you knock them out. When you KO a character using "Shatter", Slow enemies within 3 spaces of the target.

techniques.name: Dramaturge
techniques.flavor: Why so glum, you're living in hallowed times! I've even graced you with my presence! Enjoy it while you can!

levels.name: All Eyes On Me
levels.text: Once per Action, when you roll a Crit for any reason, you may spend 1 AP or 3 Focus to ‘Elevate' the roll. When you Elevate describe how your character adds some dramatic flair or additional detail to the roll they're taking and increase the Tension by 1.

levels.name: Snatch Their Fire
levels.text: When you increase Tension, create ‘False Tension' instead. False Tension is counted separately from normal Tension and is added to Tension on player's Turns, being turned back into False Tension on enemy Turns.

levels.name: Power In Presentation
levels.text: When you Elevate specific actions, they receive a bonus: ‣ Finisher: Deal [Tension] additional damage (counting the Tension added via Elevate). ‣ Charge: Gain AP equal to the AP spent on this Action (not including AP spent on Elevate). ‣ Interact: You may Mark, Immobilize, Taunt, or Fear your target, if multiple Crits were rolled choose one additional option for each Crit.

techniques.name: Feral Arcana
techniques.flavor: Magic isn't a thing you own, you don't create it and you aren't its master. The magi borrow from something greater than themselves, it's only natural that I return the favor once in a while.

levels.name: Vorpal Claw
levels.text: Your Cast can now only target one character within 2 spaces of you and Snares the target on a Success, this overrides any range or targeting modifiers or replacements outside this Technique. You may Roll Body instead of Spirit for Cast's Roll.

levels.name: Unchain [ Charge Interact]
levels.text: If the Interact has no → target, you may forgo the effects of that Interact to begin tracking ‘Fury' a 6 Segment Clock, and fill one Segment for each enemy adjacent to you + [Tension]. While you have at least one Fury Segment, you can only spend AP on Jumps or Finishers, your Jumps are Swift, and when you end a Jump's movement you must Swiftly Cast at no Cost targeting all characters adjacent to you. When you end your Turn empty 1 Fury Segment, when Fury empties it disappears, and you are Dazed.

levels.name: Grasp
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. If you have at least 1 Fury Segment and you use a Body Finisher, you may spend all your Fury Segments to gain [Tension] Advantage and move up to 3 spaces before targeting.

techniques.name: Flame Heart
techniques.flavor: Brother, trust that this hurts me almost as much as it's gonna hurt you.

levels.name: Rev Up
levels.text: When you Breathe you may ‘Ignite', receiving up to 6 damage and Blighting yourself to receive an additional Focus for every 2 damage taken. You receive half the damage from Blight.

levels.name: Damning Impact
levels.text: If you Cast or use a Spirit Finisher while Blighted, you gain [Tension] Advantage, and Blight your target. When you would Blight an enemy who's already Blighted you deal [Tier] damage.

levels.name: Ashes To Ashes
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. Your Spirit Finisher has a range of 5 and removes Blight from its target and yourself after targeting, if it removes any Blight it additionally targets two 5 space diagonal Lines centered on the targeted space.

techniques.name: Grim Ascendant
techniques.flavor: It started from the extremities furthest from his heart. Beat by beat, Otes lost feeling in his fingers and toes. After legs came his sight, he must rely on his instinct. And finally it enveloped him, a dark blessing, a grim perversion of the natural world, an immoral exploitation of his masters, and the only chance he had left.
techniques.notes: Transformation. Can't take with other transformations.

levels.name: Impermanent Power
levels.text: Once per Scene, when you Charge with at least 2 Tension, you may ‘Transform', gaining 2 AP, pushing all enemies within 2 spaces of you 3 spaces away, and losing Health until you reach 1, gaining double the Health lost in Focus. While you're Transformed the first Cast of your Turn is Swift and damage / healing you receive affects your Focus rather than Health. When you are reduced to 0 Focus while Transformed, you lose the Transformation and become Dazed.

levels.name: Drain Life
levels.text: When you use a Spirit Finisher while transformed, you may choose to deal half the normal damage to begin Regenerating on a Success.

levels.name: Umbra
levels.text: When you lose your Transformation, you may Knockout yourself to use a Spirit Finisher targeting a 3x3 Zone centered on yourself.

techniques.name: Long Draw
techniques.flavor: Eros, a $20k compound bow custom-made for easy disassembly and shots from a distance upwards of 2000 meters. It boasts a draw weight of 200 lbs and the ability to pierce the armor of most vehicles or military grade armor. It's Mayflower's calling card, and one of the few things that proves they ever existed.

levels.name: Nock The Arrow
levels.text: Gain a new action, ‘Prepare'. Prepare costs 1 AP, is always Swift, and when you use it you gain one stack of ‘Prep'. When you use a Skirmish or Talent Finisher, spend all your Prep stacks to gain 2 additional range and 2 Advantage for each stack spent.

levels.name: Feather Step
levels.text: When you Prepare you may move one space so long as you don't move into adjacency with an enemy.

levels.name: Lord Piercer [ Prepare × 3 ]
levels.text: Gain 1 AP, your next Skirmish or Finisher this Scene (can't stack) can target all characters in a Line with a length equal to its range. If said Attack targets a character at the attack's maximum Range (minimum 2 spaces away, maximum the edge of the board), the attack deals additional damage equal to the Prep spent.

techniques.name: Mana Blades
techniques.flavor: My spirit was focused, ready. I have honed it into a sharpness few things have ever known. It is almost disappointing that most will only see it once.

levels.name: Call Arms
levels.text: Wherever you use a Cast or Spirit Finisher, you may spend 1 Focus to have it benefit from your Techniques that would normally affect Skirmishes.

levels.name: Tools Of The Fallen
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. After you successfully Cast using "Call Arms" you may place a "Fallen Blade" in an unoccupied space adjacent to your target. When you enter the space of a Fallen Blade, it's removed, and you Strengthen.

levels.name: Saintly Sword, Excalibur
levels.text: Choose a Weapon Technique that you don't have, when you Attack while Strengthened you can use all three levels of your chosen Weapon Technique as if you had it.

techniques.name: Void Soul
techniques.flavor: You've been told you're hard to notice, easy to ignore. If only they knew how right they were.

levels.name: Return To Nothing
levels.text: When you Teleport you may Banish yourself, making this feature unusable until the end of your next Turn.

levels.name: Fade Away
levels.text: The first time you Dodge or move to the edge of the board each round, you can spend 1 Focus to Teleport to another unoccupied space on the edge of the board.

levels.name: Hollow Heart
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Void', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after every Scene. When you Teleport or become Banished fill one Segment on your Clock, when you use a Spirit Finisher while the Clock is filled you may ‘Blot The Stars', targeting all enemies in a 5x5 zone centered on the center of the board, dealing half damage to each.

techniques.name: Thunder Blood
techniques.flavor: Plenty of kids in this country have spent sleepless nights watching the White Hounds, sparks flying down mountains and trees, descending from the clouds. Inevitably they'll be told by those older and wiser that there's no such thing, and when I was that age I almost listened. Thank god I didn't, the wind against my face is so exhilarating at this height.

levels.name: Raiden
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Static', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after each Scene. When you Breathe you can fill two Segments. So long as you have one Segment filled, you are immune to the effects of Daze.

levels.name: Energized Incantation
levels.text: When you successfully Cast, you can empty a Static Segment and then Daze yourself to do one of the following: ‣ Blink: Teleport to a space adjacent to your target ‣ Shock: Inflict Daze. ‣ Chain: Swift Cast on a different enemy in 5 spaces of your initial target at no cost.

levels.name: Discharge
levels.text: Your Casts gain 1 Advantage. Double the Static Segments filled from "Raiden". When 3 or more Segments are filled on your Static Clock, your Spirit Finisher targets a 3x3 Zone centered on yourself (without targeting yourself), and Dazes its targets on a success. If a target was already dazed they receive [Tier] additional damage.

techniques.name: Zealot
techniques.flavor: The brass has sullied all we hold sacred! The machine is in the garden, and nectar coats its teeth!

levels.name: Heretical Devotion
levels.text: Begin tracking ‘Insight', a 6 Segment Clock that's emptied after each Scene. Once per Action, when you roll a 1 for any reason, you may spend 1 Focus to fill an Insight Segment. When you Charge, Cast, or Spirit Finisher, you may empty an Insight Segment to have your final Hit count treated as [Spirit + Tier] x 2 minus the number of Hits rolled.

levels.name: Always Watched, Drowned In Tears
levels.text: When you start your turn with 4 or more Insight Segments filled, you may Strengthen yourself and have every character in the scene inflict Fear on you.

levels.name: Never Meant To Be
levels.text: When you use a Spirit Finisher with a full Insight Clock, you may empty all the Segments to have it target two intersecting∞ length lines anywhere on the board. All characters targeted are moved one space off of the line in a direction of your choice and the targeted spaces are removed from the game, destroying any Terrain on them or connected to them. If a character would enter one of these spaces, they are instead Teleported to the closest space on the opposite side of the Line.

techniques.name: Creation Ascetic
techniques.flavor: This city is a heretical idol, incomplete, unstable, and fallen to vice. My men and I have tried to negotiate its salvation, but these creatures seem unable to save themselves. Be thankful we are so graceful.
techniques.notes: Alt Resource. Can't take with other alt resources.

levels.name: Forming Signs
levels.text: You now use ‘Creation Marks' instead of Focus. You start all Scenes with no Creation Marks. You can only gain Creation Marks using Breathe and Charge. When you make an attack with any number of Creation Marks you must spend all of them and gain an effect based on the number spent and the Attack used. 1-2 & Cast: Crossing Nails: Target two adjacent 3 space long Lines where at least 1 space overlaps with the other Line. 3+ & Cast: Impossible Mallet: Target every enemy exactly 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 spaces away from you, dealing additional damage equal to this number. 1-2 & Finisher: Celestial Pile-Arm: Gain 2 Advantage. Your target is pushed as far as possible, and receives one damage for every space pushed 3+ & Finisher: Living Idol Gain 4 Advantage. Target up to 6 spaces adjacent to each other where one is adjacent to you, these spaces also become high-ground.

levels.name: One True World
levels.text: Your first Breath you use on your turn is Swift, your Charge has its cost reduced to 1. When you deal damage to or destroy terrain you gain a Creation Mark.

levels.name: Labor Of The Devout [ Cast Finisher ]
levels.text: This → Finisher counts as having spent an equal amount of Creation Marks as the Cast used before it. Joel's Notes: Using Summons If you're creating a character who can use Summons or enemy actions it's important to familiarize yourself with the gm-side enemy rules on page X.

techniques.name: Ego Arm
techniques.flavor: Two minds as one, united in a pursuit of glory.

levels.name: I Am Your Sword
levels.text: After Deploying or Breathing adjacent to a willing ally you may ‘Transform', becoming a weapon they use. So long as you're Transformed you take up the same space as your user, can't be targeted, and can't willingly move. If your user is Knocked Out you are Knocked Out, and either of you can split at the start of your Turns, placing you in an unoccupied adjacent space. A character can only use one Ego Arm.

levels.name: Show Your Targets
levels.text: When your user ends their Turn, you may spend 2 AP to place a ‘Damocles Marker' in the space of every enemy they attacked on their turn. When you use a Spirit Finisher, you may have it deal half damage to have it target all enemies on spaces with Damocles Markers.

levels.name: And I'll Become Irreplaceable
levels.text: When you use a Spirit Finisher targeting Damocles Markers, you may spend an additional 1 AP to remove them and gain 1 Advantage for each Marker removed.

techniques.name: Sellsword's Call
techniques.flavor: The Keepers of Lear had some of the strangest partners. The Fairies rarely take the shape of elves, seeming to prefer hounds and rodents. Their reputation for violence is worse than those animals they imitate.

levels.name: A Warrior's Reprise
levels.text: When you Cast targeting an empty space, you may spend 1 Focus for each empty space and create a Tier 1 Ranger, Executioner, or Viper Summon there. The Summon has 1 Health and can only deal half of any damage it would normally deal. You can only have [Tier / 2] Summons from this Technique Level at a time.

levels.name: Battle Hymn
levels.text: When you Charge you may forgo the Focus gained to Strengthen your Summons and have them move.

levels.name: Supreme Sellsword
levels.text: Once per Scene when you use a Spirit Finisher targeting one empty space, or Deploy, you may spend 3 Focus and create a DPS Summon of your choice with a Tier equal to yours. That enemy is a named character who has a Rank 3 Bond with you.

outlooks.name: Rebel
outlooks.description: Those who've lost their belief in, and respect for, the authority above them. Be it The Rebel's immediate superiors or those completely out of reach.

gifts.name: Until My Last Breath
gifts.text: When at 2 Stress or higher, you gain 3 Advantage on Body and Talent Rolls. ( Stress does not exist in combat hence this cannot affect it.)

gifts.name: Insolent Dissident
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, when you don't have a Buddy, you can freely make a Rank 2 Bond outside Intermissions, but doing so gives them the Buddy Tag. When you take the Shenanigans Bond Action with someone who is officially your superior you can roll 2 dice instead of one.

gifts.name: Supernatural Deafness
gifts.text: You don't have an Ability and can't use other supernatural equipment. In exchange, you gain double the Advantage from Bonds and gain 3 Character Ranks.

gifts.name: Not Today
gifts.text: When you or one of your Bonds would be attacked you may choose to become the target and nullify the attack. Roll a dice for each of the following questions that are answered with "yes" and take 1 Stress for each that doesn't Hit . ‣ Was the attacker a named character. ‣ Are you unbonded with the attacker. ‣ Does the Narrator think the attack could kill you.

gifts.name: Overexertion
gifts.text: When you make a roll, you may go All Out by taking a Stress instead of spending an Influence (this does not give you Influence ).

gifts.name: Leave This To Me...
gifts.text: When an ally is forced to take Stress from another character you may offer to take over, letting you Duel that character at no cost if the ally allows it.

outlooks.name: Loyal
outlooks.description: A person dedicated to, and participating in, the systems and authority of those in power. The Loyal's oath to this cause reaps benefits others could only dream of.

builtin.name: The Oath
builtin.text: This must be taken in addition to your two starting Boons if you choose "The Loyal" as your Outlook. This Boon can't be taken after Tier one. You have an Oath, a single word that you embody, at any point the narrator can invoke your Oath to ask you to act in a specific way, if you do so you gain 1 Influence.

gifts.name: Fish Out Of Water
gifts.text: When you use Examine while your Subject is doing something that would normally be considered mundane or pedestrian you may take one Stress instead of spending Influence as if it was one of your Favored Bond Actions.

gifts.name: Durandal
gifts.text: You've been entrusted with a massively important weapon or tool. Note what it is and what it excels in as if you were creating a Skill. When your tool is applicable in a Challenge Roll, gain 2 Advantage and you may go " All Out" by gaining 1 Stress instead of using Influence.

gifts.name: My Master's Teachings
gifts.text: Gain a Rank [Tier/2] Teacher Bond with an NPC you've met or of your creation. You may always use the "Learn" Bond Action with them even if they are not in the Scene.

gifts.name: Lord's Rite
gifts.text: You hold information about law and the State. 1/C hapter, you may choose an unnamed character in a scene and give them a full name. The GM must then tell you if they are a criminal, and if so, the most notable crime they have committed.

outlooks.name: Light
outlooks.description: A provider, protector, or pacifist, and more importantly than any of that, a person to be depended upon. The Light naturally draws those in their darkest hour.

gifts.name: Saint
gifts.text: You have 2 Advantage on Rolls against characters who have no negative feelings towards you.

gifts.name: Friendly And Approachable
gifts.text: Your Quick Bonds with non-player characters start at Rank 2. You may also form more than one Quick Bond in a Chapter by taking one Stress when doing so.

gifts.name: Performance Artist
gifts.text: Choose one of your Skills, it gains an additional Rank. When first get an Extreme Success with your chosen Skill in a Scene, anyone Bonded with you can remove 1 Stress.

gifts.name: True Hero
gifts.text: When you Awaken you may use the Protect Bond Action on any named character even if they were not Bonded with you at no cost, if you're protecting them from a character you may also Duel that character at no cost.

gifts.name: Books And Their Covers
gifts.text: When you offer to befriend someone who's tried to kill you before, you may spend 1 Influence to force the Narrator to either have them accept the offer or give you 3 Influence. If this is attempted on the same character more than once, the Narrator can deny it without giving you Influence.

outlooks.name: Wolf
outlooks.description: A person scarred and scared, left behind by or who has left behind those who they depended on most. The Wolf is a loner, though they're unlikely to stay that way.

builtin.name: Lone Wolf
builtin.text: This must be taken in addition to your two starting Boons if you choose "The Wolf" as your Outlook. This Boon can't be taken after Tier one. You can only have 3 Bonded characters at a time, you always know where someone you're Bonded with is.

gifts.name: The One Thing You Can Rely On
gifts.en: The One Thing You Can Rely On
gifts.text: You may form Bonds with weapons as if they were characters, when you do so they're Rank 1 and Partners. Weapons made via an Ability all count as the same weapon.

gifts.name: Dark Urge
gifts.text: When you attempt to use your Ability in a Challenge Roll you may choose to gain 4 Advantage, if you roll an odd number of Hits your Narrator can have you use a Skills or Ability on a character you weren't targeting, you can resist this by taking 2 Stress. Gain 4 Character Ranks that can be spent on your Ability.

gifts.name: Outgunned
gifts.text: When you're working against more enemies than you have allies, you gain 2 Advantage on all Rolls.

gifts.name: Guard Dog
gifts.text: When you only have 1 Bond , the Rank of that Bond is treated as being 2 Ranks higher when used in a Roll and are always Tagged as your Ward (this can surpass the Rank 3 maximum).

outlooks.name: Mentor
outlooks.description: Wise for your years, no matter how many, a towering beacon of experience and strength. Though maybe this isn't The Mentor's story to use this.

gifts.name: Old, Calloused Hand
gifts.text: Write two "Calluses", a negative event that you've dealt with before, leaving you stronger. When you're presented with a Threat related to your Callus, you may lose 1 Stress.

gifts.name: Past Your Prime
gifts.text: You may only choose this when creating your character. You start with 12 Character Ranks for Skills and your Ability rather than 8, and must spend at least 8 on Skills. Gain one less Character Rank every Tier.

gifts.name: An Organized Style
gifts.text: When you use your Ability in a way you've never used it before, you can give that specific usage a name to gain 3 Advantage.

gifts.name: A Power That Must Never Be Used Again
gifts.en: A Power That Must Never Be Used Again
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, your Ability can instantly kill any unnamed NPC standing in front of you regardless of context. If you ever use the effect of this Boon, you lose two Bond Ranks with a character of your choice. If you lose all of your Bonds, you lose control of your character permanently.

gifts.name: Perspective Of A Teacher
gifts.text: Your Bonds with Students always count as being 2 Ranks Higher when used in a Roll (this can surpass the Rank 3 maximum). When you only have one Student and you use Influence with them present, they gain an Influence.

outlooks.name: Apprentice
outlooks.description: Bright-eyed greenhorns looking to make up for the experience they lack and make a name for themselves. The Apprentice starts small, but holds big ambitions.

gifts.name: Never Give Up!
gifts.text: When you fail a Challenge Roll with 1 or more Stress, you may immediately retry the Roll with 1 Advantage for every point of Stress you have.

gifts.name: Amazing Potential
gifts.text: You may only choose this when creating your character. You start with 6 Character Ranks for Skills and your Ability rather than 8, but you only need to spend 2 on Skills. Gain one extra Character Ranks every Tier.

gifts.name: Land Among The Stars
gifts.text: When an opponent rolls more dice than you in an Opposed Roll, you gain 1 Influence.

gifts.name: Plenty To Learn
gifts.text: When you go All Out, you may flash back to a Scene where you were taught something relevant to your current Roll . Doing so grants you 4 Advantage.

gifts.name: A Step Behind, But Still Running
gifts.en: A Step Behind, But Still Running
gifts.text: When you Awaken in an unstructured Scene you gain 3 Advantage on the next roll you make.

outlooks.name: Accursed
outlooks.description: Doomed from the beginning, a being of ill fortune, granted power they never asked for. What is the power? How can they get rid of it? The Accursed rarely knows.

gifts.name: Volatile Blood
gifts.text: You do not need to keep any of your original words when using your Ability.

gifts.name: Uncontrollable Power
gifts.text: Your Ability is now formatted as "You [Verb] [Noun] When You [Condition]". Meaning, their effects are always applied when the condition is fulfilled. Gain 4 Character Ranks that can be spent on your Ability.

gifts.name: Sacrifice
gifts.text: You may use this Boon after any Roll to make it a Extreme Success by sacrificing one of the following (It can't be restored, only replaced). ‣ Your eye. ‣ Your arm. ‣ Your leg. ‣ Your tongue. ‣ Your life.

gifts.name: Turning Over A New Leaf
gifts.text: When a problem occurs that could be easily solved using one of your Ability, you may lose 2 Stress and choose not to use your Ability instead.

gifts.name: Tainted Body
gifts.text: One or more of your limbs or eyes are wrapped in bandages or otherwise concealed from other people. Once per Series, when you spend Influence, you may reveal this body part to gain 3 + your Tier Character Ranks to spend on gaining and/or Ranking up a new Ability.

outlooks.name: Blessed
outlooks.description: Living in near-edenic plenty, a person granted fortune beyond imagination. Some combination of pride and ignorance is almost necessary for The Blessed.

gifts.name: A Web Of Connections
gifts.text: When you use Influence, you can identify an unnamed NPC in the Scene. You gain 2 Advantage on Rolls where that NPC is relevant.

gifts.name: Trust Fund
gifts.text: You have 10 ‘Funding Tokens', when you make a Roll you may spend any number of Funding Tokens to explain how you use your wealth to help you and gain equal Advantage. Gain 5 more Funding Tokens when you Tier up.

gifts.name: Convenient Transport
gifts.text: You always have access to some sort of all-terrain vehicle or mount that can carry up to 8 people.

gifts.name: Social Setup
gifts.text: Once per Chapter, you can spend 1 Influence to claim you have connections in the place you're in or relating to what you're doing. When you do this, Roll Mind with Advantage equal to your Tier and set all hits aside. Any time you're in a Scene with an unnamed character, you may claim that that person is the one you mentioned with this Boon and gain Advantage on all rolls relating to them equal to the Hits you set aside.

gifts.name: Do You Know Who I Am?
gifts.en: Do You Know Who I Am?
gifts.text: When you dramatically introduce yourself around unnamed characters, you may use this Boon to prompt them to: gasp, become interested in you, or make fun of you (Narrator's choice). When you get a reaction you haven't before gain an Influence.

outlooks.name: Quiet
outlooks.description: One of the little people in someone else's story, living a life with little personal image. Though it's hard to say how many of The Quiet would like a story of their own.

gifts.name: The Talent
gifts.text: When you Awaken a Skill in the middle of a Challenge Roll, you gain 3 Advantage.

gifts.name: The Sneaky Superposition
gifts.text: At any time when your exact position is unclear, you may gain 1 Stress to appear somewhere else within reason.

gifts.name: Reversal Of Fortune
gifts.text: When you successfully respond to a Threat coming from another character with a Roll and get at least 1 Crit, you may reverse the situation. When you do so you levy the Threat you were responding to against them, the narrator must either have them receive its effects or give you 2 Influence.

gifts.name: Gearhead
gifts.text: You can now create ‘Gadgets' by spending Character Ranks. They are treated as Abilities for their creation, costing, Ranking, and usage in Rolls. Unlike Abilities, Gadgets are physical and can be given to, and used by other characters in Rolls, others gain one less Advantage than what you would gain. Your Gadgets can be permanently destroyed through the Risks you receive, but also refunding you any Character Ranks you spent on them. Gain 3 Character Ranks to spend on Gadgets.

gifts.name: Knacks And Hobbies
gifts.text: You gain 3 Advantage on all rolls that don't oppose or relate to another character.

gifts.name: Technobabble
gifts.text: You may use Examine with machines and supernatural objects as if they were characters, with you triggering the Crit and gaining the bonus instead of them.

outlooks.name: Confident
outlooks.description: A person who must make themselves known, who fears a decline in image more than their death. Who wouldn't agree with The Confident when your life has eyes on it.

gifts.name: Spite
gifts.text: When you lose, either in the narrative or in an Opposed Roll , to a character you're Bonded with you may assign them as the target of your Spite. When you use that Bond to gain Advantage in any sort of competition with the subject of this Bond you may also Crit on rolls of 5, if the roll is a Extreme Success that character is no longer the target of your Spite.

gifts.name: And I'll Only Use One Hand…
gifts.en: And I'll Only Use One Hand…
gifts.text: Once per Chapter when you take an Opposed Roll with someone else, you may give them a handicap. This gives them 2 Advantage and gives you 1 Influence.

gifts.name: Chatty
gifts.text: When you perform an Opposed Roll, you can begin talking, be it monologuing, quipping, taunting or ranting, gaining 2 Advantage plus any Bond ranks you have with your opponent. If you fail this roll, your character receives 1 Stress.

gifts.name: Spotlight
gifts.text: So long as you're in a Tense Scene your allies may treat the Tension as being 2 lower.

gifts.name: Perspective Of A Lancer
gifts.text: When you create a Bond or Rank Up a Bond, you may assign that character you're Bonded with as your ‘Lancer' . Your Lancer is always tagged as a Rival, even if they've already reached their max Tags, and you gain double the normal Advantage when using their Bond in a Challenge Roll. When you don't have a Lancer, you can make Rank 2 Quick Bonds outside Intermissions, but doing so makes them your Lancer.
